news.Title: 11月台股期指跌153點
news.Content:
（中央社台北27日電）台北股市今天終場漲54.8點，收46096.23點。11月台指期以46081點作收，下跌153點，與現貨相較，逆價差15.23點。

台灣期貨交易所為近2個月指數期貨契約訂定開盤參考價為，11月期貨46234點、12月期貨46362點。

台股今天終場漲54.8點，收46096.23點，成交金額新台幣9765.47億元。

11月台指期貨以46081點作收，跌153點，成交6萬890口；12月期貨以46213點作收，跌149點，成交357口。實際收盤價格以期交所公告為準。1151027

news.Title: 台股漲54.8點
news.Content:
（中央社台北27日電）台北股市今天開高震盪，收盤漲54.8點，為46096.23點，漲幅0.12%，成交金額新台幣9765.47億元。

加權指數開盤為46211.2點，盤中最高46585.45點，最低45676.67點；不含金融股指數40767.08點，漲22.85點。

八大類股漲跌幅：泥窯股跌0.77%、食品股漲0.65%、塑化股跌0.38%、紡織股跌0.31%、機電股漲0.04%、造紙股漲1.28%、營建股漲1.8%、金融股漲0.74%。

委買張數2607萬7971張，委賣張數1552萬2999張，成交張數1157萬4135張。

收盤時上漲479家，下跌534家，持平98家。

成交量前5名個股為主動中信台灣收益、友達、主動統一升級50、主動統一台股增長、群益臺灣加權正2。

漲幅前5名個股為東台、冠西電、新代、盟立、同泰。

跌幅前5名個股為泓德能源、台端、尖點、嘉基、宏致。1151027

news.Title: 【收盤】台股神龍擺尾小漲54點作收！台積電尾盤驚見6434張買單
news.Content:
台股今（27）日開高後一度跌破4萬6000點大關，盤中震盪加劇，所幸尾盤回穩，加權指數終場收在46096.23點，上漲54.80點，漲幅0.12%，成交金額達約9765億元。權值股漲跌互見，台積電（2330）收2400元，上漲15元，漲幅0.63%；鴻海（2317）收247.5元，上漲1.02%，成為撐盤要角。不過，聯發科（2454）收3960元，下跌1.25%，台達電（2308）也下跌3.21%，多空拉鋸格局明顯。

東台、濱川等9檔漲停　映興、富驊等5檔跌停

個股方面，漲停股包括東台（4526）收45.15元、濱川（1569）收94.8元、彬台（3379）收27元、冠西電（2466）收287元、大世科（8099）收85.1元、同泰（3321）收17.75元、聯昌（2431）收11.1元、上銀（2049）收328.5元及意藍（6925）收111.5元。跌停股則有映興（3597）收42.4元、泓德能源（6873）收51.7元、康聯訊（3672）收12.4元、華洋精機（6983）收293.5元，以及富驊（5465）收37.65元，跌幅介於9.82%至9.98%。

news.Title: 台股收漲54.8點　中小型股表現活躍
news.Content:

news.Title: 早盤衝漲5百點後卻震盪翻黑！台股終場驚險收紅小漲54點

news.Title: 台股震盪幅度加大，權值、記憶體、光纖股及金控股相對強勢
news.Content:
【財訊快報／方亞申】美股週一四大指數反彈，週二亞洲股市韓國及日本皆彈升。台股避開上週五大跌危機，週二開盤跟著上漲。不過論今年漲幅，台股居全球之冠，且自7月高點拉回幅度僅7.85%，相對較小，在面對聯準會、企業季報及期中選舉等變數下，不太可能出現強勢反彈。何況國際油價又來到今年高峰，西德州原油站上100美元，多少將刺激通膨。而中小型AI公司被質疑購買GPU建立算力以出售，但中間時間差所付出的成本不低，馬斯克預言可能有公司會倒閉，果真如此，可能會影響到輝達、超微業績，對台灣供應鏈又是一大考驗，加權指數終場上漲54.80點，收在46096.23點，成交量9765.47億元。台股接續長假前開高走低模式，是否因為跌幅較小進行補跌，要小心。

10月以來科技市場對於中小型公司大舉購買GPU，出售算力動作開始產生疑慮，部分公司五年期債券違約率飆升超過六成，股價跟著下跌，最具代表就是黃仁勳有投資的CoreWeave以及NBIS，股價都領先創7月低點。而馬斯克的SPACEX，已順利籌到400億美元資金，要用來購買輝達晶片，並認為約有200家中小型算力公司將倒閉，但他沒興趣收購，落井下石，進而影響股市。現階段可將CoreWeave以及NBIS股價視為指標，只要股價未止跌，對市場信心就有影響，反之將有利反彈。同屬CSP大廠的臉書完成950億美元籌資，馬斯克及輝達皆有參與。目前手上資金最多可能是輝達、SPACEX、蘋果等四大公司，股價動見觀瞻。基本上四大指數要先站上季線才是轉危為安重點。

全球股市諸如歐洲、東南亞等表現尚可，徳法皆有築底跡象。第三季前最強的日韓台美反而面臨獲利回吐賣壓。韓國表現弱勢，不宜跌破7月低點5262點。

今年以來，台股上市上漲57.9%居全球第一，其次是費半的56.5%、櫃買的36.1%。第四、五名則是韓國的34.3%及日本25.9%，原本費半及韓國都遙遙領先台灣，如今卻退至台灣之下，不是台灣太強勢就是台股需要補跌。尤其是國際油價在100美元之上，美國選前不容易下來，容易製造通膨進而升息，這反而成為最大變數。台股週二早盤上漲家數大幅超過下跌家數，但在高價股如創意( 3443 )、聯發科( 2454 )、大立光( 3008 )、信驊( 5274 )、川湖( 2059 )、健策( 3653 )以及PCB上游的玻纖布的富喬( 1815 )、台玻( 1802 )、CCL台光電( 2383 )、台燿( 6274 )以及測試探針的穎崴( 6515 )、漢測( 7856 )、精測( 6510 )，加上ABF的景碩( 3189 )、南電( 8046 )、欣興( 3037 )、臻鼎( 4958 )等幾乎全面下跌，其中也包括漲價題材如CCL及玻纖布，是否暗示利多已經刺激不了股價？

目前只有記憶體的南亞科( 2408 )、華邦電( 2344 )等族群有高獲利支撐，股價不太容易下跌。封測股有黃仁勳注資的京元電( 2449 )及日月光( 3711 )表現較優。光纖股拜美國LITE及COHR強彈，聯亞( 3081 )、聯鈞( 3450 )表現稍好。其他如嘉澤( 3533 )、祥碩( 5269 )、宏碁( 2353 )、盟立( 2464 )、技嘉( 2376 )、緯創( 3231 )、廣達( 2382 )、緯穎( 6669 )表現較好。

還有資安股的晉泰( 6221 )、大世科( 8099 )、倍力( 6874 )以及被動元件國巨*( 2327 )及華新科( 2492 )，以及機器人相關的大銀微( 4576 )、上銀( 2049 )走勢較佳。金控股表現也不弱，盤中部分個股都還創新高。集團股就看台塑及華新集團股。

基本上台股指數累計下跌較小，優於日、韓、費半，屬於非常強，但也要小心補跌出現，預計44000點以下支撐強。

news.Title: 台股驚險收紅漲54點！台積電站穩2400元 CCL台燿爆鬼故事跌停
news.Content:
國際油價下跌、半導體股反彈，美股周一收高，標普500指數及那斯達克指數終止連續兩周下跌，日股強彈逾千點，韓股強漲近4%，台股在經歷颱風與光復節4天連假後，今（27）日一度上漲逾500點，指數來到46585點。但盤中賣壓出籠，台股上午10點過後由紅翻黑，下探45676.67點，收盤靠著台積電拉抬，再度翻紅上漲54.8點，以46096.23點作收。

台積電一度反彈至2405元，尾盤湧現6434張大單，終場收2400元，記憶體及被動元件指標股反攻，南亞科及華邦電漲逾5%，國巨漲近3%。但台達電續跌逾3%，聯發科一度回測3910元，聯電跌逾2%。

CCL(銅箔基板)個股成重災區，傳出台燿亞馬遜AWS最新Trainium 4訂單被搶單，由於Trainium 4主要採用M9等級材料，是明年CCL廠出貨主力，衝擊台燿股價跌停，台光電跌逾6%。

台股連續休市4天，期間費城半導體指數連續兩個交易日反彈，但仍不足以完全收復10月22日的跌幅。不過，台股在上周四已先行重挫逾800點，外資當日賣超逾800億元，市場已提前反映部分國際利空。

分析師提醒，台股本周迎來重要財報與總經事件，包括10月28日聯電召開法說會，蘋果也將發表新品；10月29日除友達、台達電法說會外，還有聯準會利率決議，牽動台股走勢。

道瓊工業指數上揚146.42點，或0.28%，報52361.58點。那斯達克指數漲214.04點，或0.83%，報26169.38點。S&P500指數上漲53.09點，或0.70%，報7676.77點。費城半導體指數勁揚304.01點，或2.82%，報11083.47點。

news.Title: 台股急殺失守46K！ 記憶體力挺撐盤 南亞科一度飆8%
news.Content:
台股今（27）日上演大怒神行情！受美股反彈激勵，加權指數早盤開高走高，一度大漲逾500點、衝上4萬6585點，不料隨後賣壓出籠，欣興（3037）、台光電（2383）等高價股翻黑，指數急轉直下，盤中上下震盪逾908點，再度失守4萬6千點。截至中午11時58分，加權指數暫報45924.94點，下跌116.49點，跌幅0.25%，成交金額已達6841億元。盤面上，記憶體族群成為資金焦點，南亞科（2408）、華邦電（2344）逆勢走強。

記憶體族群點火

記憶體族群今日表現亮眼，受到韓國半導體大廠股價反彈帶動，南亞科盤中最高衝上449元，漲幅達8.45%，截至上午11時58分暫報442元，上漲6.76%；華邦電上漲4.21%，報161元，旺宏（2337）上漲2.51%，力積電（6770）上漲4.67%。此外，晶豪科（3006）上漲5.77%，十銓（4967）上漲4.6%，記憶體模組及相關封測股也多數走揚。市場另有投顧報告預估，明年DDR4供需缺口可能達20%，為相關族群帶來想像空間。不過，南亞科近期仍面臨法人調節，投信已連續8個交易日賣超，累計賣超逾1.6萬張，後續買盤能否延續仍受關注。

高價股翻黑拖累大盤

台股早盤原本氣勢如虹，台積電、記憶體、ABF載板及AI概念股同步帶動指數上攻，但隨著欣興、台光電等高價股賣壓湧現，盤勢迅速翻轉，大盤由大漲轉為下跌，再度跌破4萬6千點。個股方面，記憶體相關股多數上漲，巨虹則逆勢下挫8.09%，暫報12.50元，成為盤面弱勢股之一。市場在急漲急跌間震盪，顯示資金追價態度仍有分歧。

旺宏、力成下午法說

今日盤面另一項觀察重點，是旺宏與力成（6239）將於下午舉行第三季法人說明會，公布最新財報及第四季營運展望。記憶體報價走勢、供需變化，以及相關封測需求能否延續，預料都將成為法人關注焦點。

（封面圖／東森新聞）

news.Title: 台股紅翻黑！她才PO片喊「一路向上」　網朝聖：發信心文必崩
news.Content:
台股今（27）日開高後突然賣壓湧現，加權指數最低下探45798.23點，下跌逾240點，一度面臨4萬5000點保衛戰。好巧不巧，有「反指標女神」之稱的財經網紅巴逆逆，昨天半夜才在臉書PO出影片，預告台股將一路向上，並放話她將補回正二（群益臺灣加權正2）。眼見台股盤中無預警變盤，網友紛紛回頭朝聖，直呼巴逆逆「發信心文必崩」、「真的不虧是巴逆...」。

巴逆逆喊話「很穩」卻遇台股變盤　網友調侃：光劍真準，跳一下就縮

巴逆逆昨夜自拍影片在臉書分享，並信心喊話：「大家不要擔心！ 台股就是很穩的！」片中巴逆逆表示，原以為上週四（22日）台股將迎來世界末日，沒想到看起來穩了，並預告隔天一早她就將補一張正二。她還拿起伸縮玩具光劍，預告台股一開盤就會一路向上。不料，她第一次甩劍失敗，劍立刻縮回，直到第二次才成功甩出。

今早她又曬出台指期強漲的截圖，寫下「我都有在聽師父的話，所以每天早上起來都一柱擎天！」，看起來對行情頗有信心。不料，台股開高後賣壓湧現，加權指數一度上漲逾500點，隨後卻急轉直下，由紅翻黑、下殺逾240點。眼見走勢與預期不同，巴逆逆也在貼文底下連喊「wtf....? wtf....!!!!???」、「撐著啊啊 撐著啊啊啊」。

兩篇貼文底下頓時再湧入不少網友朝聖。網友笑稱「妳一發文馬上噴回去，拜託妳下次可以安靜看盤就好嗎」、「看到盤中下殺，趕快來看是不是8ZZ發文了，果然」、「又是妳……」、「不發文手很癢嗎」，還有人調侃「這光劍真準、跳一下就縮了」、「原本說個股就算了，現在是要展現通殺的氣勢？」、「買正2害死人，通殺」，甚至有人喊話要她改買反向ETF。

news.Title: 台股漲跌震盪激烈，記憶體、權值及金控股扮演重要角色
news.Content:
【財訊快報／方亞申】美股週一四大指數反彈，週二亞洲股市韓國及日本皆彈升。台股避開上週五大跌危機，週二開盤跟著上漲。不過論今年漲幅，台股居全球之冠，且自7月高點拉回幅度僅7.85%，相對較小，在面對聯準會、企業季報及期中選舉等變數下，不太可能出現強勢反彈。何況國際油價又來到今年高峰，西德州原油站上100美元，多少將刺激通膨。而中小型AI公司被質疑購買GPU建立算力以出售，中間時間差所付出的成本不低，馬斯克預言可能有公司會倒閉，果真如此，可能會影響到輝達、超微業績，對台灣供應鏈又是一大考驗。而台股接續長假前開高走低模式，即使跌幅不深仍要小心。

今年以來，台股上市上漲57.9%居全球第一名，其次是費半的56.5%、櫃買的36.1%。第四、五名則是韓國的34.3%及日本25.9%，原本費半及韓國都遙遙領先台灣，如今卻退至台灣之下，不是台灣太強勢就是台股需要補跌。尤其是國際油價在100美元之上，美國選前不容易下來，容易製造通膨進而升息，這反而成為最大變數。台股週二早盤上漲家數大幅超過下跌家數，但在高價股如創意(3443)、聯發科(2454)、大立光(3008)、信驊(5274)、川湖(2059)、健策(3653)以及PCB上游的玻纖布的富喬(1815)、台玻(1802)、CCL台光電(2383)、台燿(6274)以及測試探針的穎崴(6515)、漢測(7856)、精測(6510)，加上ABF的景碩(3189)、南電(8046)、欣興(3037)、臻鼎(4958)等幾乎全面下跌，其中也包括漲價題材如CCL及玻纖布，是否暗示利多已經刺激不了股價？

目前只有記憶體的南亞科(2408)等族群有高獲利支撐，股價不太容易下跌。封測股有黃仁勳注資，京元電(2449)、日月光(3711)表現較優。光纖股拜美國LITE及COHR強彈，聯亞(3081)、聯鈞(3450)表現稍好。其他如嘉澤(3533)、祥碩(5269)、宏碁(2353)、盟立(2464)、技嘉(2376)、緯創(3231)、廣達(2382)、緯穎(6669)表現較好。

還有資安股的晉泰(6221)、大世科(8099)、倍力(6874)以及被動元件國巨*(2327)及華新科(2492)、亞翔(6139)以及機器人相關的上銀(2049)、大銀微(4576)走勢較佳。金控股表現也不弱，盤中都還創新高。

基本上台股指數優低於韓股、費半，屬於非常強，但也要小心補跌出現，預計44000點以下支撐強。

news.Title: 美股修正近尾聲？摩根士丹利：「3大變數」牽動標普500年底上看8000點
news.Content:
摩根士丹利的 Michael Wilson 表示，6 月開始的股市看跌修正已進入最後階段。人工智慧（AI）資本支出疑慮、美國期中選舉的不確定性，以及聯準會（Fed）的流動性變化，這三項關鍵因素有望促使市場觸底，並為年底標普500指數反彈至8000點鋪路。

根據《Seeking Alpha》報導，在市場週期轉向中期階段之際，市場內部已受到衝擊。這一轉變恰逢去年「解放日」前後的滾動式經濟衰退觸底後，企業獲利預期修正廣度變化率達到高峰。

隨著投資人轉向品質較高的因子股，包括半導體、金融、非必需消費品及汽車在內的早期週期類股，表現明顯落後。

Wilson 在週一（26日）發布的報告中進一步指出，自市場週期轉換開始以來，羅素3000指數成分股中約有60%的股價跌幅超過20%。其中，半導體產業受創最深，該產業有96%的成分股跌幅超過20%。

在這波市場轉變期間，品質因子股一直表現領先，目前更已呈現突破走勢。Wilson 指出，儘管標普500指數展現出韌性，市場廣度也已開始改善，顯示隨著市場逐步消化中期週期轉換的影響，指數表現與市場內部狀況正逐漸趨於一致。

Wilson 表示，短期策略性下檔目標仍為7100至7200點，意味著指數可能小幅跌破200日移動平均線。撰文時，標普500指數約在7688點附近，距離10月初創下的歷史高點不到2%。

Wilson認為，市場修正要真正結束，仍有3項風險需要逐步釐清。

首先是AI投資疑慮。未來3至4週，投資人對AI相關議題的疑慮可能集中浮現，包括資本報酬率、資金成本與可取得性、安全問題，以及「鄰避效應」（NIMBYism），也就是地方居民反對在住家附近興建相關設施的現象。

其次，美國期中選舉通常會在初期對市場形成壓力，但選舉結束後6至12個月的股市報酬率往往相當強勁。從歷史數據來看，標普500指數在期中選舉後12個月的平均漲幅約為17%。

第三，也是最重要的一點，Wilson 指出，流動性是目前市場面臨的最大風險，也是促使市場最終觸底的關鍵催化因素。

聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh） 已將資產負債表的擴張速度放緩約一半，同時在通膨仍高於目標的情況下，利率政策仍落後於通膨變化。美國金融情勢已大幅緊縮，程度與2018年相當，且接近2022年刻意緊縮政策期間的嚴峻程度。

摩根士丹利的綜合市場情緒指標目前處於中性水準，且第三季企業獲利預計年增27%。Wilson 維持原有看法，認為隨著這些關鍵因素在未來幾週逐步明朗，市場應會浮現具吸引力的買進機會。

news.Title: 【Hot台股】南亞衝高後跳水跌逾3%！網哀「多蛙連環套」分析師：不宜搶反彈
news.Content:
今日社群台股最Hot議題

「南亞再破 多蛙連環套」、「南亞從高點殺了十趴下來 累積一根!!!!」、「還好我南亞317先跑」、「南亞大戶吃飽了」、「又是殺豬盤」、「南亞太噁心了吧 開盤+5%追進去的被剁爛了」。

「南亞主力很會玩 技術線型破位拉回是上車點」、「南亞該發車了吧」、「6213聯茂 1303南亞 連2交易日套好套滿 多頭屠殺場」、「看看南亞聯茂這走勢,有可能回去嗎?」。

針對網友熱議話題…專家這麼說！

HOT台股今日值班專家－顧德投顧分析師黃紫東

南亞（1303）今（27）日早盤開高走低，股價一度衝上321元，漲逾6%，隨後賣壓出籠，由紅翻黑，盤中最低來到290.5元，股價跌逾3%。

不少股民哀號「南亞再破，多蛙連環套」、「開盤追進去的被剁爛了」。黃紫東表示，南亞今日開盤先反映上周利空傳聞澄清後的反彈，但隨著PCB（印刷電路板）族群同步修正，短線獲利了結賣壓浮現，加上南亞10月以來漲勢相對強勁，部分資金開始調節，導致股價開高走低。

黃紫東指出，南亞今日走勢也受到大盤開高後承壓影響，由於PCB族群普遍走弱，相關供應鏈也受到影響，盤中要再出現大幅反轉並不容易，預估今日收黑機率較高，重新站回300元的機會也不大。不過，他認為目前仍屬漲多後的合理修正，並非產業基本面出現重大問題。

至於後續走勢，黃紫東表示，南亞目前仍維持在月線附近，短線可先觀察285元能否守住，若PCB族群賣壓逐漸消化，預估經過一至兩周整理後，股價才比較有機會重新站回300元。

黃紫東建議，目前PCB族群有資金撤出的跡象，暫時不適合加碼，若是在300元以上追進的投資人，建議先觀察月線支撐與後續整理情況，不必急著增加持股部位，等待族群賣壓消化後再評估。

湯暖萱／財經特派記者，主跑主計處、營建、百貨紡織等

news.Title: 台股5萬點不遠了？童子賢看好台積電全年EPS衝百元：本益比不算高
news.Content:
台股今（27）日結束4天連假後開高走低，市場關注指數能否進一步挑戰5萬點大關。和碩（4938）董事長童子賢今日受訪時表示，股市反映的是產業價值與經濟成長，台灣整體基本面仍相當不錯，尤其台積電（2330）今年每股盈餘（EPS）有望超過100元，而美國大型證券公司分析師甚至給出「3字頭」的目標價，顯示市場願意給予更高的本益比評價。

台股挑戰5萬點 童子賢：股市反映產業價值與經濟成長

童子賢表示，回顧兩、三年前，台股指數還在2萬多點，若未來上漲至5萬點，與兩年多前相比幾乎翻倍。他指出，「股市是經濟的門面」，反映的是產業價值與經濟成長，從這個角度來看，「台灣的本質還不錯」，其中又以台積電為首，帶領台灣產業一路向前。

談到台積電獲利表現，童子賢指出，從台積電公布的前三季獲利和第四季接獲的訂單來看，他相信台積電今年全年EPS將超出原先市場預期，有機會突破百元。

童子賢強調自己是工程師，習慣從數字來說話。若台積電每股獲利能夠超過100元，以今日開盤2,400多元的股價來看，本益比也不過20倍出頭。他認為，相較全球熱門科技股，這樣的本益比其實不算高。

外資目標價喊「3字頭」 估本益比上看35倍

童子賢透露，自己已經看到美國大型證券公司分析師給予台積電「3字頭」的目標價，而台積電目前股價才2,400多元。他推估，若美國幾家重要證券公司願意給出3,000元以上的目標價，代表這些外資券商願意給予台積電約30至35倍本益比的評價。

至於台股持續上漲，是否有機會邁向5萬點，又會不會有漲得太高的疑慮？童子賢表示，「所謂的高跟低，我建議大家看它的本質」，如果企業獲利良好、經濟成長不錯，市場給予相對不錯的本益比來反映股價，「我覺得這是一個合情合理的發展趨勢」。

馮萱榕／財經特派記者，主跑財政部、電腦通路、觀光餐飲等

news.Title: 【台股盤中】漲逾500點後翻黑　科技權值股失色
news.Content:

權值股台積電 (2330) 今天開盤跌破半年線，最多漲20元至2405元，聯發科 (2454) 下挫70元為3940元，台達電 (2308) 低點來到1490元，跌70元，鴻海 (2317) 在平盤245元附近游走。

台股盤中有多檔股票漲停，包括東台 (4526) 、濱川 (1569) 、彬台 (3379) 、冠西電 (2466) 、倍力 (6874) 、大世科 (8099) 、盟立 (2464) 、同泰 (3321) 、尚茂 (8291) 、聯昌 (2431) 等。

銅箔基板族群表現弱勢，其中台燿 (6274) 跌停至1280元，聯茂 (6213) 從漲停到翻黑，台光電 (2383) 跌逾6%，重挫330元，南亞 (1303) 開高走低，盤中跌逾2%。

台股今天盤中成交量排名，以主動中信台灣收益（00406A）居冠，除ETF之外，個股以友達 (2409) 逾20萬張最高，其次為力積電 (6770) 、台玻 (1802) 、南亞 (1303) 、聯電 (2303) 、群創 (3481) 。

news.Title: 聯發科法說倒數、投資人先跑？失守4000元創2個月盤中最低
news.Content:
IC設計龍頭聯發科（2454）即將於本周五（30日）舉辦線上法人說明會，然而法說會前觀望與避險氣氛濃厚，外資提款賣壓未止。聯發科今（27）日開低走低，盤中最低觸及3,955元，挫55元，跌幅達1.37%，不僅失守4,000元整數關卡，更創下近兩個月盤中新低，分析師表示，外資從10月7日開始連日賣超，投資人不得不向現實面低頭。

回顧聯發科股價表現，今年9月22日盤中才剛創下5,480元的歷史新高，隨後便陷入劇烈震盪修正。若與歷史高點相比，短短一個月內股價大幅修正達1,525元，拉回幅度近三成。

顧德投顧分析師張家豪指出，聯發科基本面表現並不差，但近期走勢明顯「敗在籌碼面」。外資自10月初以來持續賣超，讓市場承受極大資金壓力。

張家豪強調，一張聯發科價值近400萬元，對投資人而言心理壓力極大。即便公司基本面利多頻傳，面臨籌碼持續流出的現實，投資人仍需重視風險控制，「不得不向現實面低頭。」張家豪表示，若手中持股虧損已超過15%，建議應嚴格執行停損、適度收回資金，切勿盲目硬挺；等未來技術指標重返多頭態勢（如MACD大於0、KD大於50）後，再重新尋找布局時機。

外資連 12 賣壓頂 分析師 建議觀望為宜

倫元投顧分析師王春盛則表示，聯發科早盤失守4,000元大關，加上外資已連續12個交易日賣超，顯示籌碼面壓力沉重，短線市場信心仍需時間修復。

王春盛建議，後續除了密切觀察外資賣壓是否收斂、股價能否止跌及成交量是否適度回溫外，法說會上針對AI ASIC與手機晶片等業務的成長動能說明將是關鍵。在操作策略上，短線不宜因股價大幅拉回就急著盲目抄底；空手者應耐性等待賣壓減輕、股價打底站穩後，再行分批布局，以避免承擔過高的過早進場風險。

陳依旻／財經特派記者副組長，主跑央行、證交所、投信投顧等

news.Title: 台股光復連假後反彈逾500多點 開紅卻震盪不穩！站穩46K成疑慮
news.Content:
AI新創公司Anthropic週一提交首次公開發行（IPO）申請，為AI題材注入信心，美股晶片類股強勢反彈，加上油價回落緩解通膨疑慮，帶動4大指數全面走高。而經歷颱風假及光復節4天連假，台股今（27）日開盤上漲169.77點，以46211.2點開出後，開紅動盪，早盤加權指數最高攀升至46585.45點、大漲544.02點，將關注後續是否站穩46K。

權值股方面，台積電（2330）開盤下跌5元至2380元，而後上漲，早盤最高2405元；鴻海（2317）上漲1.5元至246.5元，最高248.5元；聯發科（2454）上漲25元至4035元，最高4075元；廣達（2382）上漲9.5元至331.5元，最高338元；台達電（2308）下跌25元至1535元，最低1500元。

news.Title: Anthropic上市前面臨債信考驗，未啟動租賃承諾增至3210億美元
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】人工智慧(AI)公司Anthropic準備首次公開募股(IPO)之際，投資人除關注其營收成長與上市估值，也開始評估大規模算力投資可能帶來的長期財務負擔。外電報導，Anthropic招股文件對取得投資級信用評等的規劃著墨不多，但公司警告可能較預期更早需要新一輪融資；截至6月底，尚未啟動的租賃承諾已達3210億美元，較去年底約500億美元大幅增加，未來如何籌措資金成為債券市場關注焦點。招股文件顯示，Anthropic截至6月底已有62億美元流動債務，為欠亞馬遜(Amazon，美股代碼AMZN)的可轉換本票。公司另有最高770億美元的潛在可轉換票據借款選項，對象包括亞馬遜、博通(Broadcom，美股代碼AVGO)及Google母公司Alphabet(美股代碼GOOGL、GOOG)。此外，摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley，美股代碼MS)牽頭的五年期循環信貸額度在9月擴大至150億美元，較先前約30億美元顯著提高。這些項目性質不同：已發行票據屬現有債務，借款選項則不代表公司已全數動用；尚未啟動的租賃承諾也不能直接視為目前到期債務。

隨著模型開發及資料中心需求推升資金支出，Anthropic能否取得投資級評等，將影響未來進入債券市場的條件及借款成本。外電引述投資級債券基金經理人指出，公司目前流動性充裕、現有槓桿相對可控，但評等機構仍須衡量未來付款承諾、相對較短的營運歷史，以及公司與商業夥伴之間的交易關係。目前能否取得投資級評等仍有待評等機構判斷，不能僅憑現有借款規模推定結果。

循環信貸條款也顯示信用評等對公司融資安排的重要性。根據外電報導，若Anthropic取得至少兩家主要評等機構的投資級評等，相關擔保及抵押權益可予解除；借款利率亦隨評等變動，A級及BBB-級對應的基準利率加碼幅度分別為75及125個基點。對債券投資人而言，除了未來可能取得的評等，也須觀察租賃付款時程、營收成長與現金流是否足以支撐持續擴張。

算力融資方面，博通週一(26日)宣布與美國銀行(Bank of America，美股代碼BAC)、黑石(Blackstone，美股代碼BX)、花旗(Citigroup，美股代碼C)及摩根士丹利合作，安排630億美元交易，透過新設特殊目的公司購買博通AI加速器及網路設備，再租賃給Anthropic使用，預計2027年開始交付。博通將就優先順位融資部分提供設備殘值支持；這項安排可協助Anthropic取得算力，但也使市場更加關注租賃義務及合作各方的信用風險。

news.Title: 《日股早盤》買盤逢低進場 日經指數上漲1.9%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-27 10:34:54 黃文章 發佈

日經指數週二早盤上漲，由於日經平均指數在前一交易日以前的連續三個交易日累計下跌逾2,400點，吸引投資人逢低進場，搶反彈的買盤增加。

10月以來跌勢較為明顯的人工智慧（AI）及半導體相關個股，包括愛德萬測試（Advantest）、軟銀集團（SoftBank Group）與雷射科技（Lasertec）等，持續受到市場追捧，帶動日經平均指數走高。愛德萬測試單一個股就推升日經平均指數逾500點。

日經225指數27日早盤收盤(台北時間上午10點30分)上漲1.92%或1,191.64點，暫收63,381.29點。東證股價指數(TOPIX)早盤收盤上漲0.58%或23.19點，暫收3,996.17點。

就類股表現來看，截至早盤收盤為止，電氣機器（2.26%）、土石製品（2.13%）漲幅較大，跌幅較大的類股為不動產業（-2.58%）、醫藥品（-2.17%）。

日經新聞報導，市場人士指出，從當天的漲勢來看，投資人對日經平均指數的技術面看法有所改善，愈來愈多人認為，代表長期趨勢的200日移動平均線，短期內可望成為指數下檔的重要支撐。因此，相關個股也出現回補買盤。

一名日本國內投信公司的策略師表示，市場對200日移動平均線形成短期支撐的預期增強，促使投資人重新買進先前下跌的人工智慧與半導體相關股票。

（圖片來源：MoneyDJ理財網資料庫）

news.Title: 參與Meta、SpaceX及Anthropic三大AI融資，高盛週一股價漲2.01%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】人工智慧(AI)企業擴張帶動融資需求，高盛集團(美股代碼GS)週一(26日)同時出現在Meta Platforms(美股代碼META)、SpaceX(美股代碼SPCX)及Anthropic三項大型融資安排中，涵蓋股票發行、晶片設備融資租賃及首次公開發行(IPO)。高盛股價當天上漲17.60美元或2.01%，收報893.28美元。Meta週一啟動約350億美元普通股及強制可轉換特別股相關證券發行，高盛與摩根士丹利(MS)擔任主要聯席簿記管理人。Meta另外規劃，在尚待新設的無表決權C類普通股開始交易後，逐步出售最高600億美元股票；該計畫預計不早於2027年第一季啟動，時間及條件仍待確定，因此兩項計畫合計最高950億美元，並非已全數募得。

在SpaceX交易方面，該公司與阿波羅全球管理(APO)管理的實體達成具約束力的承諾，擬透過約400億美元融資租賃取得圖形處理器(GPU)及相關設備。SpaceX表示，阿波羅與高盛領銜提供融資承諾，高盛並擔任唯一結構安排方；高盛資產管理部門管理的基金及帳戶也參與出資。正式租賃合約仍須完成，設備預計於2027年上半年開始交付。

AI新創公司Anthropic同日向美國證管會(SEC)提交IPO申請，計畫在那斯達克掛牌，股票代碼為ANT。公司公告列出高盛為取得初步公開說明書的聯絡機構，申請文件中的承銷商名單由高盛及摩根士丹利居前；不過，發行股數、價格區間及募資規模尚未公布。三項安排凸顯AI企業對算力和資金的龐大需求，也展示高盛在不同融資業務中的角色。

news.Title: 〈台股開盤〉四日連假開門紅 台積電、鴻海領軍漲逾500點 記憶體、機器人走揚
news.Content:
美股26日因Anthropic上市以及油價回落全面大漲，台股歷經四日休假後，今 (27) 日早盤維持紅盤，電子權值股台積電、鴻海領軍上攻，中小類股活蹦亂跳，記憶體與機器人、自動化概念股也有所表現，早盤漲逾500點，隨後遭逢5日均線壓力漲幅回落，早盤估量1.08兆元。

主要權值股方面，台積電 (2330-TW) 漲約0.52%，鴻海 (2317-TW) 漲約0.51%，聯發科 (2454-TW) 小漲約0.19%。廣達 (2382-TW) 漲約1.09%，日月光投控 (3711-TW) 漲約0.54%；台達電 (2308-TW) 則跌約2.72%。

記憶體股漲勢整齊，南亞科 (2408-TW) 漲約7.79%，晶豪科 (3006-TW) 漲約6.52%，華邦電 (2344-TW) 上漲8元、漲約5.18%，暫報162.5元；旺宏 (2337-TW) 也漲約3.77%。

機器人、自動化概念股同步走揚，盟立 (2464-TW) 漲約9.94%，暫報177元；大銀微系統 (4576-TW) 漲約8.85%，亞德客-KY (1590-TW) 漲約5.23%，所羅門 (2359-TW) 漲約5%。

晶圓代工股則呈現分歧，力積電 (6770-TW) 漲約3.69%，世界先進 (5347-TW) 漲約1.24%，暫報163元；聯電 (2303-TW) 跌約1.39%，未隨同業走揚。

news.Title: Morgan Stanley just made a bold call on Amazon stock
news.Content:
Amazon stock jumped to lead the Dow Jones Industrial Average on Oct. 19, the same day Morgan Stanley named it the firm's top pick and set a price target that would push AWS' total revenue to $1 trillion for the first time, according to Investopedia . Analyst Brian Nowak set a new target of $350, up from $335, representing roughly 40% upside from the stock's Oct. 16 close.

The upgrade lands at an unusual moment. Amazon's cloud business is expanding at a pace Wall Street did not expect. Its AI infrastructure bet is producing visible returns, and one of the company's biggest competitors just ran into a public fight with Amazon over how AI agents shop online. The stars, in Nowak's view, are lining up.

The "Rule of 90" case for buying Amazon now

Nowak's note centers on what he calls the "Rule of 90" for Amazon Web Services. The idea is that when revenue growth plus operating margin crosses 90%, a cloud business earns a premium multiple, Motley Fool reported .

AWS is not there yet, but Nowak thinks it will get there. He projects AWS growth of 47% in 2027 and 42% in 2028, with operating margins of 42% and 44%, respectively.

Also read: JPMorgan's CEO sends a stern warning to corporate America

Put those numbers together and you get an AWS business that nearly triples its revenue between 2025 and 2028. At those margins, AWS would clear the Rule of 90 threshold and, in Nowak's model, justify a higher valuation for the entire company. He sees Amazon earning around $16.50 a share in 2028, roughly 7% above the Wall Street consensus.

The projection rests on Amazon's position inside the cloud arms race. AWS grew 37% to $42.2 billion in revenue during the second quarter of 2026, its fastest pace in 18 quarters, and is now running at a $169 billion annualized rate. Amazon also raised its 2026 capital expenditure to $220 billion. CEO Andy Jassy cited falling memory prices as one reason to accelerate the spending.

AWS is betting on Bedrock and Nvidia to pull ahead

Nowak's optimism on margins ties directly to Amazon's AI platform strategy. Bedrock, AWS's managed AI service, gives enterprise customers access to at least 10 fully managed third-party models, according to Amazon's SEC filing . Nowak expects Bedrock to become a growing source of high-margin revenue as more companies run their AI workloads on AWS rather than building their own infrastructure.

The hardware picture adds to that argument. AWS and Nvidia announced in August that they would deploy an additional 2 million Nvidia GPUs over roughly the next two years, a commitment that would give AWS one of the largest GPU fleets in the world. That kind of scale matters because the biggest enterprise AI workloads require consistent, massive compute that only a handful of providers can guarantee.

Story Continues

KeyBanc Capital Markets also has a $350 target on Amazon, projecting 38% AWS growth versus a 37% street consensus, as TheStreet reported . Both firms see AWS's trajectory as underappreciated by the broader market.

Meta's Muse just handed Amazon an unexpected edge

One of the more unusual factors in Amazon's favor right now is a fight it did not start. Meta launched Muse, an AI shopping assistant, and integrated it with retailers including Walmart and Best Buy. The plan was for Muse to help users browse, compare and buy products across the web, with Meta collecting a transaction fee on each purchase, according to TheStreet .

More Amazon:

Amazon is coming for your quick Walmart run

Amazon's Alexa shopping tool faces its first big October test

Amazon pulls a best-selling pain reliever again, and customers need to check their medicine cabinets

Amazon blocked Muse from its store on Sept. 20, after Meta declined its request to remove the bot. Amazon bars outside companies from using automated tools to shop on its site, and its spokesperson said third-party agents like Muse have the same obligations as other apps.

Amazon blocked Muse for a reason. Every AI purchase routed through a Meta checkout is a transaction Amazon loses. Blocking the bot kept that money in-house.

What the $350 target means for investors

Morgan Stanley's Overweight rating and $350 price target are not a guarantee. Amazon traded near $250 around Oct. 16, meaning the stock would need to climb about 40% to reach that level. That kind of move rarely happens in a straight line, and a lot has to go right on AWS growth for Nowak's 2028 earnings estimate to hold.

Rate risk is the one to watch. Amazon has $220 billion earmarked for AI infrastructure, and that bet only pays off if enterprise demand stays strong. A pullback leaves a lot of empty rack space.

AWS is growing faster than any major cloud rival. Bedrock is signing enterprise customers. Amazon shut Muse out rather than share the checkout. Nowak's argument is that none of this is fully priced in yet, and that AWS hits the Rule of 90 before the street expects it to.

news.Title: 記憶體四雄大反攻！力積電南亞科強彈5% 可抄底了嗎？分析師喊再等等
news.Content:
韓股漲4%，記憶體四雄大反攻！受韓大廠SK-海力士反彈7%帶動，力積電（6770）、南亞科（2408）今（27日）早結束光復節加颱風四天連假就展開強勁漲勢，力積電一度漲5.7%站回70元大關，南亞科同漲幅站上444元，華邦電（2344）、旺宏（2337）也一度有4%以上亮眼反彈，十餘檔記憶體族群通通止跌翻紅，股價可以抄底了嗎？對此萬寶投顧副總錢冠州今早接受《Yahoo股市》採訪認為，主要受韓股帶動，短線只視為跌深反彈，建議不要急著追價、先等等。

記憶體利空出盡了嗎？受中國大陸長鑫科技擴廠效應，加上南韓大廠三星、海力士股價跌跌不休，台灣記憶體三雄股價也受拖累，南亞科股價從517元一路跌到414元、慘跌三成，力積電、華邦電同樣股價從高點跌掉三分之一，今日隨著海力士大漲7%，三星也漲逾5%，記憶體族群重回盤面重心。

DRAM利空出盡了嗎？專家：跌深反彈

DRAM是利空出盡？現在可以抄底記憶體了嗎？對此錢冠州建議投資人「再等等、觀察一下」。

他說，記憶這波段跌太深，包括華邦電、南亞科等龍頭股跌高過大，今早隨著韓股轉強大漲4%，記憶體股也出現明顯的「跌深反彈走勢」，他認為也算「利空出盡」，因為市場過度擔心長鑫科技擴廠效應，但隨著韓國重量級DRAM大廠三星、海力士股價守穩，尤其是海力士股價打出底型開始向上的味道，台灣DRAM跟跌的壓力少一點。

至於投資人可以進場撿便宜了嗎？錢冠州認為，不要那麼快！主要是基於大環境，他說今天台股仍陷整理盤勢，指數小高盤開出但有壓力，尤其科技股表現沒那麼強，尤其這波多頭指標PCB只剩部份二線股在漲，因此還需要再觀察一下。

何時是真正轉強可進場訊號？他認為可觀察台股融資餘額，以上周四融資大減百億元算是好現象，但只有出現一天，若接下來融資能再減100~150億元，他認為會是短線強勢訊息。因此要不要承接DRAM股還是要看美股、台股等大環境變化。過去漲勢整理的PCB也可做為參考指標，若能續強止跌帶動整體科技向上，屆時再進場為宜，現在就認為記憶體谷底已現，恐怕為時尚早。

長鑫僅占15% 投顧龍頭給出買進南亞科報告

不過今天亦有國內龍頭投顧報告點出，陸廠頭敵長鑫存儲雖擴產積極，但估僅占全球15%產能，明年DDR4供需缺口至少20%，遠高於整體DRAM約10%，因此給予南亞科買進建議。

報告亦指出包括美光等3大原廠，明年底DRAM投片月產能僅年增10~15%，目前AI Server仍有約10%周邊應用搭載DDR4，長鑫存儲重心亦已轉往DDR5。

該投顧預估南亞科明年營收年增66.8%至6946.17億元，全年EPS上看128.01元，躺賺近13個股本。

news.Title: AI晶片需求燒不停！台積電CoWoS傳漲2成 交貨最久等8個月
news.Content:
財經中心／綜合報導

AI商機持續升溫，半導體產業也掀起新一波擴產潮，不過想要增加產能，恐怕沒那麼容易。隨著各大科技業者積極布局AI晶片，先進封裝需求不斷攀升，連帶讓相關設備供不應求。

市場傳出消息，台積電CoWoS先進封裝服務可能調高價格，漲幅約10%至20%，而設備供應商的交貨時間，也從原本的3到6個月，延長至6到8個月。這波需求熱潮，也讓半導體設備市場的採購模式出現轉變。供應鏈業者透露，過去台積電每年採購設備時，通常會與供應商協商價格，或要求廠商在不調整售價的前提下，提供更多功能。不過今年情況不同，台積電並未像往年一樣重新議價，而是直接按照既有價格採購設備，讓供應商不必再面臨降價或額外增加功能的壓力，也有助於維持獲利空間。

市場傳出消息，台積電CoWoS先進封裝服務可能調高價格。（圖／民視財經網）

不只價格談判出現變化，設備能否準時交貨，更成為客戶下單時的重要考量。半導體業者指出，由於訂單大量湧入，上游零組件及加工廠商的產能逐漸逼近極限，短時間內難以迅速擴充。即使設備製造商接獲更多訂單，仍得配合零組件供應進度安排生產，導致交貨時間持續拉長。

至於為何先進封裝產能如此搶手？關鍵在於AI晶片的應用範圍不斷擴大。除了原本需求強勁的AI GPU，包括伺服器CPU，以及依照客戶需求設計的ASIC客製化晶片，也開始大量採用先進封裝技術。加上AI晶片的測試程序更加耗時，使封裝和測試產線同時面臨產能壓力，也讓晶圓代工及封測業者評估調整CoWoS報價。

另一方面，AI晶片的設計也愈來愈複雜。為了提升運算效能，業者將更多運算晶粒與高頻寬記憶體HBM整合在同一封裝中，使晶片整體尺寸持續增加。設備供應商分析，當封裝面積變大，單台設備在固定時間內能處理的數量就可能減少。換句話說，即使晶片訂單數量維持不變，業者仍可能需要添購更多設備，才能維持原有產出。

台積電董事長魏哲家指出，CoWoS依舊是客戶優先採用的封裝方案。（圖／民視財經網）

面對市場需求，台積電也積極投入新技術研發。董事長魏哲家在最近一次法說會上指出，CoWoS依舊是客戶優先採用的封裝方案，目前五倍光罩尺寸的技術已進入量產階段，且良率表現良好。未來除了朝九倍及十四倍光罩尺寸持續

news.Title: Anthropic點名台積電 警告先進晶片過度集中台灣
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-27 09:44:40 郭妍希 發佈

開發Claude的AI前沿實驗室Anthropic在首次公開發行(IPO)招股書中罕見點名台積電(2330)，警告全球最先進晶片製造產能高度集中台灣，一旦台積電營運中斷，恐嚴重衝擊AI晶片供應，進而影響公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果。

綜合外電報導，根據 招股書 ，Anthropic指出，全球AI產業高度依賴台積電先進製程。無論輝達(Nvidia Corp.)、超微(AMD)等AI晶片供應商，或自行設計晶片的亞馬遜(Amazon.com)與Google，都需要台積電將設計轉化為實體晶片，凸顯其在AI供應鏈的關鍵地位。

Anthropic列舉台灣晶片供應面臨地震、颱風、電力與供水中斷，以及兩岸地緣政治緊張、軍事衝突、封鎖、關稅與貿易限制等風險。

公司警告，若台灣發生重大事件，全球先進晶片供應可能嚴重受阻。由於替代晶圓廠建設及認證耗時，影響甚至可能持續數年。

Anthropic並指出，美國等台灣以外地區的先進製程擴產仍處早期階段，短期內恐難有效降低產能集中風險。

此外，台積電因先進製程需求旺盛，無法完全滿足市場需求，導致Anthropic未能及時取得足量晶片。

Anthropic強調，任何限制或延誤台灣及台積電先進晶片供應的情況，都可能對公司營運造成不利影響。

news.Title: 專家洩台股後市！史上最大IPO點燃熱情 台股大漲逾500點
news.Content:
史上最大IPO來了！人工智慧公司Anthropic提交首次IPO申請，預計規模大於Space X， 重燃投資人對AI產業的熱情，帶動周一半導體類股上漲，美股四大指數全面收紅；原以為台股會因颱風、光復節連續休市期間，因美股費城半導體指數22日挫跌6.72％會補跌，由於隨後費半上揚0.44％、2.82％，加上Anthropic史上最大IPO點燃投資熱情， 台股27日開盤5分鐘大漲逾500點，早盤加權指數最高來到為4萬6565點。

台積電早盤上漲20元，最高至2405元，聯發科上漲65元最高來到4075元，台達電則逆勢下跌3.21％，來到1510元；台股指數隨後漲勢趨緩，開盤20分鐘後漲200點、指數仍站穩4萬6千點大關之上。

投信觀察今年來全球主要股票市場表現以亞股表現最佳，其中以台灣加權股價指數上漲61.89％居冠，韓國36.1％居亞軍、日本28.37％名列第三。進一步觀察投信發行的海外各類股票基金平均績效表現，以亞洲型47.5％表現最佳，全球一般股票型32.76％居亞軍，主動式海外股票ETF基金上漲30.56％居第三。市場法人表示，亞股經濟成長亮眼，不妨以定期定額方式介入亞股基金。

展望金融市場接下來走勢， 群益亞太新趨勢平衡基金經理人楊慈珍表示，亞股仍受油價上升及中東局勢不確定性影響，恐推升通膨壓力，加上台韓AI類股多頭平倉，亞太股市進入高檔震盪，後續關注Q3財報指引。

亞太股市受惠AI超級週期，企業獲利成長能見度佳，股價評價仍處合理水位。短期雖受油價及獲利了結影響而震盪，仍看好中長期上升趨勢。配置上，可持續超配具經濟動能及AI產業鏈優勢的東北亞市場的資訊科技與工業相關產業。

news.Title: 《DJ在線》SoIC明年產能倍增 設備供應鏈迎商機
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-27 09:31:39 王怡茹 發佈

AI、HPC需求強勁，帶動台積電(2330)持續擴充3D IC先進封裝產能。供應鏈傳出，台積電今(2026)年SoIC月產能約1萬多片，明(2027)年將突破3萬片，新增產能以嘉義AP7為主力，相關設備需求可望同步升溫。法人表示，隨SoIC朝更高密度晶片堆疊發展，對濕製程、清洗、點膠、烘烤及自動化設備的要求持續提高，台廠包括弘塑(3131)、辛耘(3583)、萬潤(6187)、志聖(2467)、均華(6640)等，均積極布局相關設備商機，後續接單及出貨動能值得關注。

SoIC為台積電3D IC先進封裝技術，透過混合鍵合(Hybrid Bonding)將不同晶片垂直堆疊，相較傳統封裝方式，對晶圓表面潔淨度、平坦度及鍵合精度要求更高，也帶動相關製程設備升級需求。隨AI晶片架構持續演進，SoIC應用逐步擴大，台積電除既有竹南AP6產能外，正積極推進嘉義AP7布局，明年新增產能開出可望帶動設備供應鏈受惠。

在濕製程設備方面，弘塑、辛耘均為國內重要供應商。弘塑長期深耕半導體先進封裝濕製程設備，涵蓋清洗、蝕刻等製程，並持續投入新一代先進封裝設備開發；辛耘則布局濕製程及清洗設備，受惠晶圓製造與先進封裝製程持續升級，相關設備需求有望增加。法人指出，隨SoIC產能擴充，對高潔淨度製程及晶圓表面處理的要求提高，將帶動濕製程設備商機。

至於萬潤、志聖及均華，則分別布局點膠、熱製程及先進封裝自動化等相關設備。其中，萬潤積極拓展先進封裝點膠設備，志聖深耕烘烤及熱製程設備，均華則聚焦先進封裝製程設備及自動化整合。隨SoIC晶片堆疊及鍵合製程持續升級，相關設備供應商也積極配合客戶新製程需求進行開發及驗證，爭取後續量產商機。

法人表示，台積電先進封裝擴產除CoWoS持續推進外，SoIC隨3D IC應用增加，已成為另一項重要成長動能。尤其明年嘉義AP7新增產能陸續開出，加上後續美國先進封裝布局，相關設備需求可望延續。不過，各家設備商實際受惠程度，仍須視其切入製程、客戶驗證及設備交付時程而定，後續訂單與營收貢獻有待觀察。

news.Title: 連假後誰在偷拉台積電？盤中漲20元至2405元 比ADR強
news.Content:
台積電（2330）連假後補張！今（27）日盤中一度漲20元至2405元，比ADR還強，挑戰站回2400元關卡，分析師表示，短線可觀察季線2425元能否順利站回，如帶量突破季線，則有利反彈延續。

台股連續四日休假期間，台積電ADR下跌1.7%，還一度在上周四重挫4.5%。

台積電台北現股今天早盤以2380元開低走高，盤中最高觸及2405元，和上周四收盤價2385元相比，上漲20元，幅度0.84%。

倫元投顧分析師王春盛表示，台積電今日盤中回測半年線2385元後獲得支撐，目前反彈至2400元，上漲15元，搭配短線KD指標落入低檔，技術面已有低檔反彈訊號。若後續買盤持續回流，且CoWoS先進封裝報價調漲的市場消息逐步獲得驗證，將有助強化市場對先進封裝供需及獲利成長的期待。短線可觀察半年線2385元支撐，以及季線2425元能否順利站回。

王春盛指出，操作上，不宜過度追高，可等待回測支撐不破時分批布局，若帶量突破季線，則有利反彈延續；若跌破半年線，仍須提高風險控管。

news.Title: 台積SoIC明年產能拚逾3萬片；嘉義AP7成擴產主力
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-27 09:25:35 王怡茹 發佈

AI及高效能運算(HPC)需求強勁，台積電(2330)持續加快先進封裝擴產腳步。供應鏈傳出，台積電今(2026)年SoIC月產能約1萬片，明(2027)年將進一步突破3萬片，新增產能將以嘉義先進封裝廠AP7 P2為主力；此外，台積電也積極推進美國先進封裝布局，據了解，當地首座先進封裝廠將優先建置SoIC產能，顯示SoIC已成為台積電全球先進封裝擴產的重要項目之一。

SoIC為台積電3D IC先進封裝重要技術，透過混合鍵合(Hybrid Bonding)將不同晶片進行垂直堆疊，有助提升晶片間互連密度及運算效能，並降低功耗。隨AI及HPC晶片朝更高運算效能、更大記憶體容量發展，晶片整合複雜度持續提高，帶動SoIC需求同步升溫，成為台積電繼CoWoS之後積極擴充的先進封裝技術之一。

台積電目前SoIC產能主要布局竹南AP6，後續擴產重心則將逐步轉向嘉義AP7。據了解，嘉義廠將承接未來SoIC新增產能，配合客戶新一代AI及HPC產品量產時程，相關設備將持續進駐。供應鏈指出，台積電今年SoIC月產能約1萬多片，明年隨嘉義新產能陸續開出，月產能可望突破3萬片，呈現倍數成長。

值得注意的是，台積電除持續擴充台灣先進封裝產能外，也加快美國布局。據了解，台積電規劃於美國建置先進封裝生產據點，其中首座先進封裝廠將優先導入SoIC，以因應美系AI及HPC客戶對先進封裝及在地供應鏈的需求。法人認為，隨台積電持續擴大美國晶圓製造布局，後段先進封裝產能同步在地化，將有助完善當地半導體供應鏈。

展望後市，隨AI及HPC客戶持續推進新一代晶片架構，SoIC在3D晶片整合的重要性可望進一步提升。法人表示，台積電以嘉義AP7作為下一階段SoIC擴產主力，加上美國先進封裝廠規劃逐步推進，將為未來數年SoIC產能成長奠定基礎。

news.Title: 拿不到台積電晶片！Anthropic上市文件 警告台灣2大風險
news.Content:
人工智慧AI新創巨頭Anthropic於26日正式提交首次公開發行（IPO）申請，計畫在那斯達克指數掛牌，股票代號為「ANT」力拚在11月底前完成上市。根據Anthropic提交的申請書，提到台積電產能滿載與台灣供應鏈的風險，因為絕大多數先進晶片都在台灣製造。

曾經沒拿到晶片 警告台積電大風險

此外，Anthropic在文件中提到，由於台積電產能滿載，無法滿足所有客戶的需求，因此有時無法拿到足夠數量的晶片。Anthropic認為，即使台積電加速海外擴廠，但在可預見的未來，依然無法提供充足的運算能力。

Anthropic警告，全球大多數的先進晶片集中在台灣生產，這種高度集中在少數地方的模式存在重大風險，台海地緣政治緊張、天然災害、電網及供水等關鍵基礎設施，甚至是貿易法規限制等因素，都可能影響供應鏈穩定度。

台海若爆衝突 嚴重經濟損失曝光

任何限制或延誤台積電供應先進晶片的狀況，都可能使Anthropic的業務與營運狀況受到不利衝擊。Anthropic並非第一家表達此擔憂的科技巨頭，輝達、博通、英特爾及美國政府都曾警告此事的嚴重性。

美媒初估，若台海發生軍事衝突，將使全球經濟損失至少10.6兆美元。台灣也將面臨高達40%的經濟活動受到影響，可能使美國GDP萎縮5%至6.6%，日韓將受到直接衝擊，日本GDP可能衰退14%，南韓也將承受GDP驟降23%的影響。

Anthropic在文件中詳述業務發展時可能遇到的困難，除了台灣風險，全球高階記憶體產能主要集中在SK海力士、三星及美光上也令人擔憂，當供應成長速度無法滿足需求，大客戶又提前鎖定產能時，加劇供應不足的問題。

news.Title: Alphabet Must Show This on Oct. 28 or the Stock Could Stall
news.Content:
Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) (NASDAQ: GOOGL) reports third-quarter results on Wednesday, Oct. 28, and most of the attention will focus on the usual places. This includes how fast Google Cloud grew, whether Search held up, and what the capital spending number looks like. But one line matters more than any of them right now, and it sits a few pages deeper in the release: operating cash flow.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

In the second quarter, Alphabet spent $44.9 billion on property and equipment and generated $39.1 billion in cash from operations. For the first time in recent memory, the company's free cash flow was negative, at $5.9 billion. : https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1652044/000165204426000066/googexhibit991q22026.htm That is not a rounding error for a business that generated $24 billion in free cash flow just two quarters earlier. Alphabet covered the gap by raising $49.6 billion in stock and $20.3 billion in debt in June. A company that spent a decade buying back shares has started selling them.

Google Cloud is doing its part

The bull case is that this is temporary, and the second-quarter earnings report gave that case real support. Google Cloud revenue grew 82% to $24.8 billion, and more importantly, cloud operating income more than tripled to $8.8 billion from $2.8 billion a year earlier. That means cloud is now earning roughly $0.36 in operating profit per dollar of revenue, up from about $0.21. Consolidated operating margin expanded two points to 34%.

That is the chain investors need to see hold: cloud growth becomes cloud margin, cloud margin becomes operating income, and operating income becomes cash. In the second quarter, the first two links worked. The third did not.

Operating cash flow actually fell from $45.8 billion in the first quarter to $39.1 billion, even as operating income rose. Part of that was a nearly $7 billion build in inventory, notable for a company that now sells Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) chip systems through its cloud segment, as well as a jump in receivables. Those figures could reverse. But until they do, Alphabet is funding its artificial intelligence build-out with Wall Street's money, not its own.

What Alphabet needs to show

Management raised full-year capital expenditure guidance to $195 billion to $205 billion on the second-quarter call, up from $180 billion to $190 billion, according to Bloomberg Law. Alphabet generated $185.7 billion in operating cash flow over the trailing 12 months. Read those two numbers together, and the problem is obvious: At the current pace, the company is spending more than it makes, and the equity raise bought it time rather than a solution.

Story Continues

On Oct. 28, the metric to focus on is operating cash flow, and the question is whether it moves back toward the $45 billion to $50 billion range the company produced in late 2025 and early 2026. If it does, the working-capital drag was a blip, the cloud profits are real cash, and the capex budget is self-funding. The stock can keep working. If operating cash flow remains flat or slips again while capex climbs, Alphabet's AI story will be financed by shareholders, and the market will start pricing it that way.

To me, the cloud results have earned Alphabet some patience, and existing shareholders have little reason to sell ahead of the report. But anyone considering a purchase should wait for the cash flow statement, not the press release headline. One quarter of negative free cash flow is a story. Two would be a trend.

news.Title: Prediction: 3 Stocks That Will Be Worth More Than Apple 5 Years From Now
news.Content:
Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) recently reclaimed the mantle as the world's largest company by market cap, at least for a short while. However, when looking five years out, I think three stocks will be worth more: Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ: SPCX), Nvidia (NASDAQ: NVDA), and Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) (NASDAQ: GOOG).

Apple is a great company, with one of the best compounding businesses on the planet. However, the stock currently trades at a very high valuation given its growth prospects, which likely limits its upside over the next five years.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

As such, let's see why I think these three growth stocks will surpass it by the end of 2031.

1. SpaceX

With a market cap of about $2 trillion, SpaceX is the smallest company on this list, and its stock will need to deliver some pretty strong returns to overtake Apple, which has a $5 trillion valuation. However, I think a likely merger with Tesla (market cap of $1.5 billion) in the next few years will quickly close the gap.

Barring a merger with Tesla, though, I think SpaceX has the opportunity to grow into a company larger than Apple by 2031, even as a stand-alone company. CEO Elon Musk recently projected that the company will reach $500 billion to $1 trillion in annual recurring revenue (ARR) in 2027, led by its artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure business. With the company achieving a one-year payback on its chip and networking investments and planning to add a massive 10 to 20 gigawatts of computing power next year, the path to reaching that number is actually quite clear.

Throw in Starship, Starlink, and its Cursor AI coding business, and SpaceX looks poised to see massive revenue growth over the next five years. It looks as if SpaceX could actually crush Musk's $1 trillion 2030 revenue prediction, but even placing a 10-times price-to-sales (P/S) multiple on that would take SpaceX to being a $10 trillion company.

2. Nvidia

With a $5 trillion market cap, Nvidia would only have to outperform Apple over the next five years to be the larger company. Meanwhile, the chipmaker is growing much faster and is trading at less than half the valuation of Apple on a forward price-to-earnings (P/E) basis, at only 13 times fiscal 2028 (ending January 2028) analyst estimates.

Story Continues

Nvidia looks poised to remain one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI build-out. Its graphics processing units (GPUs) are still the main chips used to train AI models, while it continues to take a larger slice of spending through its networking, central processing units (CPUs), language processing units (LPUs) for inference, and open-weight Nemotron models.

Meanwhile, Nvidia is also set to ride SpaceX's huge AI spending, as the space company ramps up its computing capacity. With SpaceX consolidating on Nvidia's Vera Rubin architecture and Nvidia getting roughly $40 billion per gigawatt of power, the company still has huge growth ahead.

3. Alphabet

With a market cap near $4 trillion, Alphabet has some catching up to do to overtake Apple in the next five years, but I'd be very surprised if it doesn't. The company is the most complete AI player and has built-in advantages in distribution and monetization.

Alphabet's biggest edge is that it has taken a wide lead in custom AI chips with its Tensor Processing Units (TPUs). This gives it several advantages, starting with its cloud computing unit, where, with its own chips, it gets a payback in about a year, half the time it takes when using Nvidia GPUs. Meanwhile, Anthropic is set to become a major TPU customer, adding another revenue stream for the company.

On top of that, its TPUs allow it to train its AI models and run inference more cheaply than competitors. With Google Search as the gateway to the internet and given Alphabet's ownership of Chrome and Android, as well as a search revenue-sharing deal with Apple, the company also has a major distribution advantage that helps drive usage and growth. Its global ad network also allows it to better monetize the consumer market than upstarts.

As the most profitable company in the world entering this year, just ahead of Nvidia, and with strong growth ahead, Alphabet looks poised to be a bigger company than Apple by 2031.

news.Title: 台股休市躲崩！反彈漲逾500點  記憶體狂拉南亞科噴7％
news.Content:
美股周一全面收高，受國際油價下跌、半導體股反彈等因素帶動，標普500指數及那斯達克指數終止連續兩周下跌，日本股市強彈逾千點，韓股漲近4%，台股在經歷颱風與光復節4天連假後，今（27）日開盤上漲逾500點，約來到46563.86點。

台積電漲20元至2405元，面板雙虎群創、被動元件及記憶體股強彈，南亞科股價噴7%，力積電漲近5%。弱勢股方面，台達電續跌至1525元，聯發科失守4000元報3955元。

摩爾投顧林漢偉分析師表示，今日台股面臨連假後補跌壓力，反映休假期間國際股市震盪，電子權值股受到外資提款影響，中小型股走勢明顯分歧。不過周一美股科技股強力反彈，費半大漲2.82%，富台指期夜盤累計轉漲，今天重點觀察台積電能否帶領大盤守住季線。

林漢偉建議，投資人操作應維持「不急搶反彈、控制持股、汰弱留強」，若指標股台積電守住重要支撐、櫃買止跌，加上外資賣壓減輕，台股才有機會逐步完成打底。

道瓊工業指數上揚146.42點，或0.28%，報52361.58點。那斯達克指數漲214.04點，或0.83%，報26169.38點。S&P500指數上漲53.09點，或0.70%，報7676.77點。費城半導體指數勁揚304.01點，或2.82%，報11083.47點。

台股上周四終場大跌846.34點，跌幅達1.81%，收46,041.43點，跌破季線，成交量8792億元。

news.Title: 韓國央行料Q4出口投資續強、關注消費反彈，韓股早盤大漲逾4%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓國央行(BOK)官員週一表示，預期第四季出口和投資將維持強勁，接下來的觀察重點是民間消費能否反彈。該官員也預估，在高頻寬記憶體(HBM)生產帶動下，明年晶片產量將增加，價格可望續漲，但漲幅將放緩。韓股首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)週二(27日)早盤上漲大逾4%，三星電子及SK海力士等記憶體晶片股走強。三星電子早盤一度上漲4.9%，SK海力士漲7.3%。市場也關注SK海力士的股東回饋計畫；公司先前表示，正研議多項回饋措施，預計週三(28日)與第三季財報一併公布。

根據市場快訊，韓國央行官員在第三季經濟數據公布後指出，出口與投資在第四季仍有望為經濟提供支撐，民間消費的回升情況則是後續關注焦點。韓國央行週二公布的第三季國內生產毛額(GDP)初值季增1.0%，高於第二季的0.6%；其中出口季增2.3%、設備投資季增4.1%，民間消費則季減0.2%。

晶片產業方面，該官員預期HBM生產效應將推升明年晶片產量，價格雖可望繼續上漲，但漲幅將較先前放緩。三星電子(005930)和SK海力士(000660)均為全球主要記憶體晶片供應商，AI數據中心投資及HBM需求因而成為市場評估兩家公司業績與韓國出口前景的重要指標。

news.Title: GMO外匯交易雲端服務遭駭、勒索5千萬美元，股價週一暴跌15.65%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】日本網路服務業者GMO Internet Group(日股代碼9449)旗下外匯交易相關雲端服務遭網路攻擊，部分客戶帳戶出現未經授權的交易。集團執行長熊谷正壽(Masatoshi Kumagai)表示，攻擊者要求支付價值5,000萬美元的加密貨幣，公司拒絕付款。受客戶損失補償及事件後續影響尚不明朗拖累，GMO股價週一(26日)收盤重挫590日圓或15.65%，收在3,179日圓。受攻擊的是GMO旗下GMO Internet(日股代碼4784)提供的「Onamae.com Desktop Cloud」服務，部分用戶利用該雲端伺服器執行外匯自動交易工具。公司公告指出，有客戶反映交易帳戶遭第三方操作；可能受到未經授權存取影響的伺服器達2萬6,739台，但這個數字不等於已確認受損的客戶或帳戶數量。

綜合路透及日本媒體報導，熊谷正壽週一在部落格披露，攻擊者曾要求以加密貨幣支付5,000萬美元，GMO並未接受要求，也沒有支付款項。共同社報導，GMO週一深夜另表示，疑似攻擊者預告將於週二日本時間中午公開客戶資訊並發動勒索軟體攻擊；這是對方提出的威脅，是否實際發生仍有待確認。

日本財務大臣片山皋月(Satsuki Katayama)週二表示，政府將以急迫態度因應事件，並要求金融監管部門視情況採取適當且迅速的措施。據外電報導，片山表示已有五家外匯交易公司回報客戶受到GMO事件影響，但目前未收到新的未經授權交易通報。GMO先前也已請求政府協助，研議運用「主動式網路防禦」措施遏止攻擊。

客戶補償方面，GMO表示，將對確認因未經授權交易造成的損失提供補償，並向受影響服務的現有用戶每人發放5,000日圓慰問金。事件發生之際，日本多家企業近期接連遭遇網路攻擊，政府已表示將研擬緊急因應措施；對GMO而言，客戶損失規模及最終財務影響仍待釐清。

news.Title: 統一證券：台股技術面仍為弱勢整理
news.Content:
【昨日盤勢】：

受SpaceX、美超微與Meta強勁財報疊加新制勞退基金將再撥款500億進入台股的利多激勵，上周四台股早盤跳空開高，然逢高賣壓出籠，午盤更傳出中東衝突升溫，加重盤勢賣壓，終場台股下跌逾800點，收盤失守季線。盤面電子股再度成為外資提款變現重災區，金融及電信股族群買盤逆勢撐盤。此外，資訊軟體受惠AI帶動資安需求，成為電子買盤資金避風港，多檔個股亮燈漲停，表現強勢。權值股方面，台積電下跌1.45%、鴻海下跌2.00%、聯發科下跌3.14%、廣達下跌1.98%，台達電下跌4.00%。盤面強勢股，華經、驊宏資、東捷資訊、晉泰、麗臺、碩禾等20檔個股漲停；泰合、力新、東台、GOGOLOOK、百達-KY等漲幅6%以上。盤面弱勢股，今國光、聯一光、天二科技、光頡、律勝等16檔個股跌停；光環、聯亞、鈺邦、華新科、台紅、台郡等跌幅9%以上。終場台灣加權指數下跌846.34點，以46041.43點作收，成交量8792.31億元。三大類股漲跌互見，電子下跌2.11%、傳產下跌1.60%、金融上漲0.62%。次族群方面，以水泥、資訊服務及食品表現較佳，分別上漲2.83%、1.49及0.83%。

【資金動向】：

三大法人合計賣超994.67億元。其中外資賣超815.82億元，投信買超94.92億元，自營商賣超273.77億元。外資買超前五大為台泥、台玻、中鋼、台新新光金、台塑化；賣超前五大為友達、南亞、台塑、國巨*、台積電。投信買超前五大為友達、台泥、台玻、日月光投控、欣銓；賣超前五大為聯電、台塑化、緯創、長榮航、中信金。資券變化方面，融資減104.93億元，融資餘額為6338.8億元，融券增2.39萬張，融券餘額為21.65萬張。外資台指期部位，空單增加1,221口，淨空單部位87,297口，借券賣出金額322.38億元。成交比重：電子84.17%、傳產13.39%、金融2.44%。

【今日盤勢分析】：

Fed將於本週召開利率決議，市場預估維持利率不變機率約90%，會後主席華許對通膨與後續升息的說法將是市場關注焦點；Anthropic 週一提交首次公開發行(IPO)申請，重新點燃市場對AI投資熱情，加上油價回落緩解通膨疑慮，帶動美股四大指數同步上漲。台股後市分析如下：

第二、輝達在柏林GTC大會公布AI供應鏈擴產布局，攜手日月光投控旗下矽品擴充CPO光引擎產能，目標於2027年中擴至15倍、2028年底達30倍。隨Vera Rubin平台與AI工廠加速部署，精密對位、耦光貼合及光電測試需求同步升溫，萬潤、高明鐵、惠特積極布局相關設備，爭取矽光子量產商機。

news.Title: Anthropic's Billions in Microsoft Commitments Add to Its Mounting Compute Bill
news.Content:
Anthropic's IPO is shaping up to be the ultimate Rorschach Test for the AI bull market.

Bulls see one of the most revolutionary companies in history, which, just five years after its founding, is leading the generative AI push, and whose Claude chatbot and related tools have become essential for millions of businesses and everyday users.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Bears, on the other hand, see a company writing checks that its chatbots can't cash. It has over $500 billion in future spending commitments and reported an $80.7 billion generally accepted accounting principles ( GAAP ) loss in the first half of the year, though that was mostly related to changes in valuations of its convertible debt due to the company's soaring valuation.

The bull vs. bear debate is about to get real once the AI stock goes public at an expected valuation of $2 trillion, but investors got a chunk of information to chew on from its S-1 prospectus out on Monday, and one of the noteworthy factoids was Anthropic's relationship with Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT).

Anthropic will pay Microsoft at least $45 billion

Microsoft was the last of the three big cloud computing platforms to invest in Anthropic, in part due to its close relationship with OpenAI, but the Windows parent is one of several cloud platforms Anthropic has contracted with for computing power.

According to the S-1, Anthropic will spend at least $44.9 billion between November 2026 and May 2033, regardless of its usage, and the agreement is mostly non-cancellable.

Anthropic has committed to spending $114.5 billion during a similar time frame with Alphabet , $110 billion with Amazon through 2036, and approximately $3.1 billion per month with Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ: SPCX) through 2029.

That list is not exhaustive of its spending commitments and implies at least $400 billion in cloud infrastructure spending over the next several years.

What it means for Anthropic

Anthropic spent nearly $9 billion on compute and infrastructure in the first half of the year, and that was its biggest line item cost by far.

The company's future cloud spending commitments go hand in hand with its growth. Computing power is what drives the business, and spending on it is as elemental as a restaurant spending on food.

The numbers may be eye-popping, and they do imply a lot of risks in the business if demand doesn't show up, but computing power is scarce right now, and Anthropic needs to make such moves to secure compute, or it will struggle to grow.

Story Continues

Investors scared off by such commitments may be better off taking the other side of the bet and investing in the cloud computing giants. Of course, those companies are spending hundreds of billions on building out those data centers to provide companies like Anthropic with the computing they need, and stocks like Microsoft are clearly less risky than AI start-ups like Anthropic.

The bull vs. bear debate will continue no matter what happens when Anthropic goes public, but the AI lab's debut will give investors a clear idea of where AI sentiment stands today. There's a lot of upside and downside to Anthropic stock, especially in the coming months.

news.Title: 1分鐘讀財經》台股周年慶先搶5大族群！台積電又見漲價大利多
news.Content:
小編今天（27）日精選5件國內外重要財經大事。台股從高點下殺超過3千點，台積電也回落至2400元之下，雙雙失守季線，在此之際，台積電傳出利多消息，先進封裝醞釀漲價，且漲幅上看兩成。

台股挑戰5萬點未果，進入回檔修正階段，但長線仍受內外資看好，並將55K視為低標，此時反而是分批佈局的時機，先進製程、封裝、載板、散熱、電源模組等族群受矚。

【1】台積CoWoS傳喊漲上看2成

AI晶片搶產能，先進封裝醞釀漲價。供應鏈透露，台積電CoWoS報價醞釀新一波調漲，漲幅上看2成，部分封裝交期已拉長，產能吃緊壓力持續升高。搶產能效應同步延燒設備端，業者直言，客戶已無暇砍價，只要能承諾交期便下單，設備交期最長拉至八個月，供應鏈全面拚交貨、拚擴產。

【2】內外資挺台股 5字頭信心堅

台股光輝10月變調，才差點站上5萬點大關，隨後受制國際變數，外資法人本月以來賣超台股逾8,200億元，導致加權指數迅速下挫，不過，高盛證券、凱基投顧等大型研究機構不改長線正面觀點，直指55,000～57,500點才是台股多頭本波段歸宿。

【3】台股買點到 Q4看旺到隔年Q1

根據歷史經驗，第四季美國期中選舉後不確定消除資金回流，常帶動美股與台股攜手展開波段攻勢根，據統計，2000年以來，台股第四季一路漲到隔年第一季，單季平均報酬率分別高達4.7％及4.6％，現在正是布局絕佳時機。

【4】中小企融資患不均 金管會出手

解決中小企業放款融資「患不均」，金管會多箭齊發，最新進度為請銀行公會於官網設立專區揭露中小企業融資諮詢窗口，22日正式上線，專區除了有38家國銀中小企業對口單位及人員外，更清楚載明金管會銀行局申訴窗口、經濟部中小企業處「馬上辦服務中心」及銀行公會對口單位，希望徹底解決中小企業放款患不均現象。

【5】全球超級央行周登場 市場估美歐日按兵不動

全球超級央行周登場，美國、加拿大、紐西蘭、歐洲及日本央行將密集公布利率決策。市場預期，美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）與日本央行本周按兵不動，12月可能進一步緊縮貨幣政策；加拿大與紐西蘭央行則可能升息1碼，防止通膨預期進一步攀升。

news.Title: 【盤前焦點】美股收高台積電ADR漲　法人：台股壓力可望紓緩
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘智義台北2026年10月27日電）台股因颱風與光復節補假休市，期間美股費城半導體指數22日挫跌6.72%，但隨後兩個交易日分別上揚0.44%、2.82%，週一台積電ADR漲1.4%。台股即便有測試半年線45121點壓力，不過法人認為，長假後買盤進場，加上本週美國聯準會（Fed）利率會議應不升息，指數下跌壓力可望紓緩。

人工智慧（AI）公司Anthropic提交首次公開募股的申請文件，帶動AI交易回暖，使美國股市主要指數26日收盤走高。道瓊工業指數揚升146.42點或0.28%，收52361.58點；標準普爾500指數上揚53.09點或0.70%，收7676.77點；那斯達克指數攀升214.04點或0.82%，收26169.38點；費城半導體指數大漲304.01點或2.82%，收11083.47點。

台股22日下跌846.34點，收在46041.43點。

國內外產業訊息方面，人工智慧AI晶片大廠輝達（NVIDIA）近日在官網發布技術文章，分享鴻海 (2317) 採用輝達AI訓練和推理技術為核心的AI伺服器和資料中心等軟硬體方案，應用在鴻海自身開發的AI模型，以及在全球打造AI智慧工廠及AI代理應用，提升鴻海集團AI訓練效能和製造效率。

搶攻AI高算力與高階電子材料商機，騰輝電子-KY (6672) 宣布，在泰國大城府的東南亞首座生產基地啟用，預計2026年底量產；騰輝也同步推進中國昆山廠新台幣15億元擴產計畫，預計2027年第2季開始量產。

低軌衛星與毫米波通訊元件廠昇達科技 (3491) 最大客戶跨入新一代低軌衛星，加上新進大客戶加速追趕，零件需求量龐大；除低軌衛星星系加速擴張之外，因應人工智慧（AI）需求，衛星應用由通訊進一步朝資料處理與運算延伸，低軌衛星市場正加速擴張。

日本國際工具機展覽會（JIMTOF 2026）26日起登場，台灣工具機暨零組件工業同業公會表示，共有94家台灣業者參展，呈現台灣工具機產業由整機製造、關鍵零組件到製程周邊設備的供應體系，並展現製造彈性與系統整合能力。

news.Title: 日經指數週一跌0.8%連三黑創3個月新低，東證逆漲0.18%、能源商社股撐盤
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】日本股市週一(26日)呈現分歧走勢，半導體與人工智慧(AI)相關權值股持續承壓，拖累日經225指數連續第三個交易日收黑，終場下跌503.51點或0.80%，收在62,189.65點，創7月30日以來最低收盤水準。儘管日經225成分股有149檔上漲、73檔下跌，整體漲家數仍占優勢，但半導體等高權重股跌勢主導指數方向，凸顯日股短線資金輪動與類股表現分化。反觀，東證指數(TOPIX)逆勢小漲7.17點或0.18%，收在3,972.98點，反映資金轉向能源、資源及綜合商社股，抵銷部分科技股賣壓。日本股市延續上週科技股修正格局，美國大型科技企業財報即將密集公布，市場持續檢視AI龐大資本支出的獲利前景，半導體設備股首當其衝。Screen Holdings收盤下跌4.34%，Kokusai Electric挫跌4.29%，網路二手交易平台Mercari重挫6.21%。此外，愛德萬測試(Advantest)、東京威力科創及迅銷等高權重個股亦對日經指數構成明顯壓力，使指數表現落後整體市場。

類股方面，東京證交所33個產業類股中有22類收紅，以礦業、石油與煤炭製品、批發業及海運業表現較佳，非鐵金屬、電機及證券商品期貨相關類股則相對疲弱。中東能源供應風險持續支撐資源相關企業股價，能源開發商INPEX大漲4.90%，為日經成分股漲幅之冠，三菱商事上漲4.14%，反映市場對能源上游與綜合商社業務的關注升溫。

題材股方面，網路安全公司趨勢科技(Trend Micro)逆勢上漲4.20%，但GMO Internet Group因旗下外匯交易服務遭網路攻擊，涉及未經授權存取及客戶損失賠償，股價暴跌15.65%，創2011年3月以來最大單日跌幅。

news.Title: 韓股急殺催抄底潮，散戶10月砸3,154億韓元買進三星與海力士槓桿ETF
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓國股市近期大幅回檔，卻吸引散戶逆勢加碼押注半導體權值股反彈。根據韓國交易所(KRX)與金融資訊機構Koscom統計，10月1日至23日期間，韓國個人投資人淨買入14檔追蹤三星電子(Samsung Electronics，005930.KS)及SK海力士(SK Hynix，000660.KS)的單一個股槓桿型指數股票型基金(ETF)，合計達3,154億韓元(約2.21億美元)，為7月底監管機關提高交易門檻後，首度出現月內累計淨買入，顯示部分散戶認為晶片股經過急跌後，已浮現短線反彈機會。韓國監管機關7月31日起收緊單一個股槓桿ETF交易規定，將個人投資人的最低保證金要求由1,000萬韓元提高至3,000萬韓元，並加強風險教育及交易限制，藉此抑制過度投機。散戶7月原本淨買入相關14檔產品約2.77兆韓元，但8月及9月分別轉為淨賣出6,484億及4,979億韓元，直到10月才重新回流。其中，追蹤SK海力士的7檔產品10月吸引2,263億韓元淨買盤，三星電子相關7檔產品則獲淨買入891億韓元，顯示投資人對AI記憶體龍頭反彈的押注尤其積極。

個別產品方面，KODEX SK海力士單一個股槓桿ETF10月獲散戶淨買入1,529億韓元，在韓國掛牌ETF中排名第11位。追蹤韓國大型股指數的KODEX槓桿ETF及KODEX半導體槓桿ETF，也分別吸引約1.04兆及2,564億韓元買盤。韓國首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)10月1日至23日累計重挫18.83%，激發部分投資人透過槓桿工具逢低布局。相較之下，外資操作較為保守，同期淨賣出相關14檔單一個股槓桿ETF共488億韓元，其中SK海力士相關產品遭淨賣出508億韓元，三星電子相關產品則小幅淨買入20億韓元，凸顯境內散戶與海外機構對半導體股短線前景的看法出現分歧。

市場人士指出，韓股近期受到美國科技股修正、人工智慧(AI)投資回報疑慮及全球風險偏好降溫影響，半導體權值股波動明顯放大。本週三星電子及SK海力士將陸續公布最新業績，美國微軟、Alphabet及亞馬遜等科技巨頭也將揭曉財報，AI數據中心資本支出、高頻寬記憶體(HBM)需求及晶片價格走勢，將成為檢驗散戶抄底押注能否奏效的重要依據。不過，槓桿ETF主要追蹤標的資產每日報酬的倍數，在股價反覆震盪時，除了放大單日損失，也可能因複利效果侵蝕長期績效。隨著韓股近期大幅回檔，散戶資金重新流入高槓桿產品的趨勢，亦使市場關注相關交易是否再度加劇股價波動。

news.Title: Find Strong Cloud Stocks With This Zacks Tool
news.Content:
Zacks Thematic Screens lets you dive into over 30 dynamic investment themes shaping the future. Whether you're interested in cutting-edge technology, renewable energy, or healthcare innovations, our themes help you invest in ideas that matter to you.

Let's take a closer look at the 'Cloud Computing' theme and take a glance at a stock within, namely Microsoft MSFT.

Cloud Computing Overview

Cloud computing refers to the on-demand seamless access of computing resources such as servers, storage, databases, networking, software, analytics, and intelligence over the Internet (the cloud) on a pay-per-use pricing model.

It marks a paradigm shift from traditional on-premises infrastructure storage to remote cloud-based storage facilities and relies heavily on virtualization and automation technologies. Instead of buying, owning, and maintaining physical data centers and servers, organizations access a virtual pool of shared resources from a cloud service provider on an as-needed basis.

This lowers operating costs, increases productivity with greater agility and flexibility, and improves scalability with higher economies of scale.

Microsoft Earnings This Week

Many have grown skeptical of the immense capital being thrown around in the broader AI frenzy, which helps explain some recent volatility we've seen among the broader tech sector. Investors are beginning to demand results from the investments for understandable reasons, driven by the lofty forecasts we've seen over the past several years.

Concerning consensus expectations for Microsoft's upcoming release, earnings are forecasted to grow 14% YoY on 16% higher revenues, maintaining an overall solid growth profile.

Bottom Line

Thematic investing has emerged as a powerful way for investors to sync their portfolios with emerging trends. A mix of long-term and short-term themes is increasingly dictating which companies lead as economies expand and markets shift.

While stocks in each theme aren't direct recommendations, they offer a solid starting point. Leverage the Zacks Rank and other metrics to identify the best stocks for your strategy. Each featured stock comes with a Zacks report, giving you the tools to analyze performance and potential.

The Cloud Computing thematic list, which currently Microsoft MSFT is part of, focuses on technology companies that provide the related hardware and software to enable cloud computing services, the communication service providers that offer the network facilities and the various firms that utilize the services across diverse sectors like financial, consumer discretionary and industrials.

news.Title: 韓股與日股弱勢、費半反彈，台股止穩與否看權值股
news.Content:
【財訊快報／方亞申】美國股市最弱勢的費半上週五小反彈，尚未創7月底低點。亞股日韓週一持續下跌，韓國股市創4月7日以來新低點；日本股市則接近7月時低點。所幸週一費半出現反彈。台指期貨夜盤下跌580點，由於這次下跌是市場對大型科技及中小型向科技公司出售高階算力的新型雲端服務商（neoclouds）資金成本產生信心問題；市場也對大筆購買GPU的公司獲利要多久產生疑慮，是否也間接影響投行對AI公司股價產生下修，都要注意。而接下來還有聯準會開會、Alphabet等超大規模雲端業者財報以及美國期中選舉變數，加上川普說要加大轟炸伊朗，後續不穩定因子仍未解決，台股上週四收盤在46041點，從高點49968點拉回幅度7.85%，今年以來累計漲幅居全球主要股市之冠，相對韓日及費半10月以來跌福13-26.02%小很多，台股是否出現補跌？要注意。權值股是止跌與否所在。美國科技股又在10月出現高點後下跌，已經下跌三週，主要是neoclouds廠商CoreWeave被認為2030年違約率飆高至60%以上，股價創7月來低點，臉書財報公布後先小漲後再大跌，黃仁勳則認為AI伺服器需求很強，但是伺服器從訂單轉換成成品伺服器交到客戶手中，需一段時間，但是需求端必須先付錢，兩者落差時間，中間變數多，且支付貨品加上利息支出，致使貸款端如銀行擔心廠商獲利時間可能超過預期，違約風險提高。使得從neoclouds到記憶體、光纖、半導體設備再到大型CSP廠，股價全面下跌，半導體股全面下修股價。而費半指數距離7月時低點10445點不遠，10月以來下跌約20%，一旦跌破就看1萬點支撐。

另一方面就是季報公布後大多數公司跌多漲少，與7月時類似；月底美、日、歐央行要開會，聯準會對於通膨看法是焦點。接下則是11月初美國期中大選，國際油價被趁機拉抬，西德州油價登上100美元。對股價都有影響。

而同樣受惠AI上漲的韓國及日本週一持續下跌，韓國收盤價已來到5500點之下，主要看三星電機、三星電子及海力士，韓國指數10月以來下跌26%。日本股市也同步下跌，10月以來下跌13%。日、韓、費半指數10月從高點以來下跌13-26%。而歐洲股市德國、法國及北歐股市卻是底部形成盤堅推升。國際股市表現不同調。國際油價高漲來到今年高點附近，是要較小心。

道瓊工業指數10/26上漲146.42點或0.28%，收52361.58點；S&P500指數10/26上漲53.09點或0.7%，收7676.77點；NASDAQ指數10/26上漲214.04點或0.82%，收26169.38點；費城半導體指數10/26上漲304.01點或2.82%，收11083.47點。

台股上週四大跌，收在46041點，但是累計從10月高點49968點下跌至今，跌幅僅7.85%，相對日、韓與費半跌幅小得多，補跌壓力不容小覷。指數雖跌破季線，但跌幅尚小，是否會補跌？除非費半指數能夠快速拉升至12000點之上，否則台股不是補跌就是橫向盤整。

而電子股還是指數是否止跌所在，台積電(2330)、聯發科(2454)、日月光控股(3711)、欣銓(3264)、聯亞(3081)、南亞科(2408)、PCB族群的台光電(2383)、台燿(6274)、聯茂(6213)、華新科(2492)、信昌電(6173)、禾伸堂(3026)、緯創(3231)，是台股反彈與否所在。馬斯克與黃仁勳要共同投資南韓ABF，觀察是否對欣興(3037)、景碩(3189)、南電(8046)、臻鼎-KY(4958)有影響。資訊服務的華經(2468)、精誠(6214)、晉泰(6221)、倍力(6874)等相對強勢。

金控股具有高配息機會，台塑集團的台塑化(6505)、南亞(1303)、華新(1605)、台泥(1101)等有間歇性推升機會。

news.Title: Target has a problem that sends shoppers to Amazon
news.Content:
Target has always been my retail destination of choice, but I don't even have its app on my phone. That's because if I need something quickly, I go to Amazon.

If I need something only available from Target and I need it fast, I'll place my order on Uber Eats, even though it will often cost more than buying it in-store.

It's a weakness for the retail giant, as it's losing sales to Amazon and Walmart because those retailers offer next-day, and in some cases, same-day delivery.

That's an area where Target has been quietly investing in an effort to bridge the gap with its rivals.

Target improves its delivery

While Target has never been top-of-mind for me when it comes to delivery, the chain has been expanding its reach.

"Over 60% of the U.S. population has access to quicker, easier shopping as Target expands next-day delivery of online orders to more markets. Guests in more than 50 top U.S. metro areas will be able to get their purchases delivered next day — in many cases for free. It's yet another option among Target's fulfillment offerings, which also includes guest-favorite same-day services and two-day shipping," the chain shared in a press release .

Target owns Shipt , which offers free same-day delivery on orders over $35. It also offers a $99 annual membership that waives those limits.

More Target:

Target tackles a frustrating problem for shoppers

Target jumps on food trend Kroger and Publix embraced

Target rolls out another generous deal to win back customers

The chain has also expanded its selection of items available for delivery.

"Most items eligible for shipping at Target are eligible for next-day delivery. That includes hundreds of thousands of items — 85% of what we sell in Target stores," the chain shared.

Next-day delivery is free for orders over $35 or with no minimum order amount if you're a Target Circle 360 member or use your Target Circle Card for purchases.

"This is just one of the ways Target offers a convenient digital shopping experience. We already reach 80% of the U.S. population with same-day delivery — often within two or three hours — and 99% with two-day shipping. And our Order Pickup and Drive Up services are always free and available for guests on their timeline," Target shared.

Target needs to fix delivery

Target has a big bridge to cross in order to catch up to its rivals.

Walmart already serves nearly the entire country with same-day service.

"We expanded our U.S. store-fulfilled delivery areas in Q4 FY25. We can now reach 93% of U.S. households with same-day delivery," the company shared in its fourth-quarter 2025 earnings release .

Story Continues

That number climbed to 95%, according to an April press release .

eMarketer analyst Rachel Wolff warned in April that Target faces a difficult path to catching up with Amazon and Walmart on delivery speed.

"Target's delivery speed disadvantage underscores how difficult it is to catch up as Amazon and Walmart are zooming ahead. At this point, it's unclear whether Target has the means — or even the vision — to close the gaps with its competitors.

"Much of the company's turnaround strategy is rooted in returning to its pre-pandemic model, rather than reinventing the business for an age in which customer loyalty is more fragile and more spending is shifting online," she wrote.

Target tries to catch up to Amazon and Walmart

RTM Nexus CEO Dominick Miserandino had a simple response when I asked him about Target investing in delivery.

"They need to! They're the go to for that quick purchase and that feeling of getting it asap is the consumer standard," he told TheStreet.

Target COO Lisa Roath talked about delivery during the chain's second-quarter earnings call .

"We also saw meaningful gains in delivery speed. This past quarter, we fulfilled nearly 30% more same-day and next-day units than last year, and we will continue investing to get even faster," she said.

Delivery, she noted, is part of a broader effort to improve customer service.

"When we combine the impact of our in-store transitions, assortment changes, tech enhancements and improvements in inventory reliability, it all adds up to an elevated experience that is being noticed by our guests," she added.

Those efforts, Roath shared, have started to pay off.

"Overall satisfaction scores continue to improve across multiple measures of the guest experience, extending the momentum we shared with you last quarter and reinforcing that our continued investments in our teams, training and our team's tireless execution are making a difference," the COO said.

The chain has been addressing concerns that GlobalData Managing Director Neil Saunders raised in September ahead of Michael Fiddelke taking over as CEO.

"Visiting Target stores is less pleasurable and less fun than it used to be," Saunders said in an email. "There is far too much friction, and the experience is sometimes unpleasant. That's an issue as it lowers the probability of people making visits, reduces visit frequency, and weakens conversion and basket size when people are in stores," he told Retail Dive .

news.Title: Will Alphabet Stock Surge After Oct. 28?
news.Content:
Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG)(NASDAQ: GOOGL) reports Q3 2026 earnings after the market closes on Oct. 28. Wall Street analysts have an average revenue estimate of $127.8 billion, which would be a 25% year-over-year increase, and earnings per share (EPS) of $3.

Last quarter, Alphabet easily surpassed revenue expectations -- and its share price still ended up falling 7% the next day. Based on the tech giant's recent track record, investors probably shouldn't feel too confident about which direction Alphabet stock will move immediately post-earnings.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

What history says about Alphabet's post-earnings performance

The way Alphabet stock moves after an earnings report is about as predictable as a coin flip. Over the last four quarters, it has had an even split, closing higher the day after earnings twice and closing lower twice, despite beating headline EPS expectations each time. Its moves this year have been significant, closing up 10% after its April 29 report, and down 7.1% after its July 22 report.

Stretching it to the last 16 quarters, Alphabet has closed up seven times and closed down nine times. The average move is 5.2% in either direction.

Why July's beat turned into a sharp drop

Alphabet's earnings report in Q2 2026 looked great on the surface. Revenue was up 24% to $119.8 billion, Google Cloud revenue grew 82% to $24.8 billion, and EPS skyrocketed 294% to $9.11. The company's post-earnings slump makes more sense when you dig a little deeper.

Net income included about $99 billion in unrealized gains, mostly from Alphabet's investments in Space Exploration Technologies and Anthropic, and that caused the huge jump in EPS. These holdings are certainly valuable, but an increase in unrealized gains is much different from an increase in sales. Alphabet's adjusted EPS (without the unrealized gains) was $2.85, which actually missed consensus estimates by $0.04.

Alphabet also raised its 2026 capex guidance to between $195 billion and $205 billion, and management said that 2027 capex will increase significantly. The company ended the quarter with negative free cash flow for the first time in its history since going public in 2004. The heavy spending worried investors and resulted in a sell-off.

What to watch on Oct. 28

Story Continues

There are a few potential swing factors, outside of revenue and EPS, to watch for in Alphabet's Q3 earnings. Any updates to its 2026 capex, as well as early guidance for 2027, could cause a big move, especially as rates have gone up and investors have become increasingly concerned with AI spending.

Free cash flow will give an idea of how manageable Alphabet's spending is. CFO Anat Ashkenazi said it will "remain under pressure" in the Q2 earnings call. How deep in the red it ends up will likely play a role in how the market reacts to earnings. Finally, Google Cloud revenue is a key metric, as it indicates that all the AI spending is turning into measurable sales growth. Ideally, Google Cloud growth will hold around 80%.

All that said, it's best to keep your expectations open. Earnings reports and post-earnings performance are inherently unpredictable. Considering how investors have rotated out of AI stocks recently, I think a decline in Alphabet stock is more likely than a surge post-earnings. However, when you're a long-term investor, what matters is what a company does over a period of years, not right after earnings.

news.Title: 聯電ADR26日上漲0.29美元漲幅1.54%折台股124.70元
Stock Market Today, Oct. 26: AI Optimism Lifts Nasdaq as Tech Stocks Rebound
news.Content:
The S&P 500 (SNPINDEX:^GSPC) gained 0.70% to 7,677, the Nasdaq Composite (NASDAQINDEX:^IXIC) rose 0.82% to 26,169 as AI optimism returned, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJINDICES:^DJI) edged up 0.28% to 52,362, diverging from Friday's energy-driven session as oil prices retreated.

Gold prices rose 0.46% to $4,026.30 as of U.S. market close and the 10-Year Treasury yield rose 0.04% to 5%, with investors favoring Real Estate and Technology stocks while Communication Services shares faced selling pressure.

Today's biggest moves

Surgery Partners (NASDAQ:SGRY) soared 48% on reports of a majority-stake takeover negotiation, while Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE) jumped 8% following a bullish price target initiation. Conversely, Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) fell 2% after filing to raise capital for AI infrastructure, and Petrobras (NYSE:PBR) plunged 14% following election results in Brazil.

What this means for investors

The big driver for Wall Street's tech stock rally on Oct. 26, 2026 was the long-awaited initial public offering (IPO) filing by artificial intelligence giant Anthropic. The company filed its S-1 prospectus to go public on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT." Its massive revenue growth figures in the filing calmed investor fears that the artificial intelligence boom was losing steam.

Anthropic's IPO revived enthusiasm for technology stocks, helping the Nasdaq Composite lead the market today despite pressure on more mature communication services providers. Adding to today's market performance was Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) stock gaining over 5%. Barclays upgraded shares to an Overweight rating, and raised its price target from $370 to $450 due to potential ties with CEO Elon Musk's other company, SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX), growth in Tesla's robotaxi business, and a recovery in its core automotive operations.

Meanwhile, Meta Platforms shares slipped after the company disclosed plans to raise up to $95 billion for AI infrastructure, signaling that the immense capital requirements for industry dominance remain a primary concern for mega-cap investors. Next, investors are looking ahead to this week's earnings from Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) and the upcoming Federal Reserve interest rate decision, which will determine if the current momentum can survive tightening financial conditions.

news.Title: Don't Miss This Week's 5 Most Important Earnings Charts
news.Content:
Earnings season picks up steam this week with hundreds of S&P 500 companies reporting earnings including several of the Magnificent 7 stocks like Alphabet, Microsoft, and Amazon.

The AI Revolution trade will also be in the spotlight with several key infrastructure companies reporting earnings.

news.Title: KLA Corporation (KLAC) vs. AMAT and LRCX: Can Rising Semiconductor Complexity Create Another Growth Cycle?
news.Content:
Is KLAC a good stock to buy? We came across a bullish thesis on KLA Corporation on Astute Optics - US's Substack. In this article, we will summarize the bulls' thesis on KLAC. KLA Corporation's share was trading at $145.61 as of October 23rd 2026. KLAC's trailing and forward P/E were 39.78 and 26.95 respectively according to Yahoo Finance.

This isn't the first time we see a semiconductor equipment company pitched as a great investment. KLAC shares gained 19.83% over the last 12 months. Comparable stocks like Applied Materials and Lam Research gained 63.07% and 46.65%, respectively, during the same period. Why are semiconductor equipment stocks rising, and does KLAC's recent weakness make this a good time to buy?

Posonskyi Andrey/Shutterstock.com

In June, we published an article about the 10 Best Growth Stocks to Buy According to Billionaire Dan Loeb and KLAC ranked #8 in that article. KLAC has declined since then, leaving investors who backed the stock waiting for that confidence to translate into returns. This article explains why hedge funds were bullish on KLAC. Before getting into our analysis, let's take a look at the business and why some investors like the stock so much.

KLA Corporation (NASDAQ:KLAC) provides tools that help chip makers find defects, measure wafer quality, and run their factories more efficiently. Its fastest-growing opportunity right now is tied to artificial intelligence-driven semiconductor demand, and that is central to understanding the stock. As chips become smaller and more complex, manufacturers need more advanced inspection and measurement tools to keep production yields high, which is exactly where KLA Corporation operates.

Read More: 15 AI Stocks That Are Quietly Making Investors Rich

Read More: Undervalued AI Stock Poised For Massive Gains: 10000% Upside Potential

In fiscal 2026, the company's revenue reached $13.6 billion, up 11.7% from a year earlier, and it kept very healthy profit margins. These are strong results, but the stock is not cheap, as it trades at about 49 times trailing earnings and 33 times forward earnings. This suggests investors are paying not just for today's performance, but also for several more years of AI-related growth.

The positive case rests on KLA Corporation being a leader in process control, meaning the tools that catch problems during chip making. Every new generation of advanced chips needs more inspection and measurement, and even tiny defects can hurt production yields. As AI pushes chip makers to expand capacity and invest in newer manufacturing technology, demand for KLA Corporation systems should benefit. The company also enjoys long relationships with leading chip makers, who find it costly and difficult to switch suppliers. Growth in advanced packaging and AI-related chip investment could support the business for years.

Story Continues

The company's recent results support this view. KLA Corporation turned a large share of its sales into real cash, generating $4.14 billion in operating cash flow and $3.8 billion in free cash flow in fiscal 2026. Its 35.6% net margin and 76.1% return on equity show how efficiently it makes money for shareholders. Fourth-quarter revenue of $3.66 billion also came in above the midpoint of management's guidance, showing steady execution even in a choppy industry. If AI-driven chip spending continues and manufacturers keep adding advanced capacity, bulls believe the company can keep growing earnings and justify its premium price.

Analysts are also fairly upbeat. Their average price target of about $233.77 implies nearly 29% upside from the current price of roughly $180.64, with individual targets ranging from $175 to $325. This bullish outlook depends on continued AI-related chip investment, strength in advanced packaging, and stable margins. However, because the stock already carries a high valuation, slower earnings growth or weaker chip spending could make that price harder to defend. You can check out why Jim Cramer recommends buying KLA stock in small doses here .

A slowdown in chip industry spending is the main risk. Even if AI demand stays strong, semiconductor equipment is a cyclical business that depends on customers' investment decisions. Wider U.S. export limits on selling chip equipment to China add another challenge, since China has historically been a meaningful source of revenue for KLA Corporation. With a premium valuation and little room for error, the stock could come under pressure if growth slows, margins shrink, or geopolitical restrictions tighten.

Another risk for the stock is that rising chip complexity makes KLA's own product development harder and more expensive. Each new manufacturing process requires inspection tools that can detect smaller defects accurately without slowing production. KLA warns that its success depends on anticipating customer needs and launching new technologies on time and at competitive costs. Existing customer relationships cannot guarantee it wins every new equipment purchase. A delayed launch or a better competing tool could cost it business even while AI investment remains strong. Higher development spending could also pressure margins before new products generate revenue. In our opinion, this execution risk could pressure KLA's valuation if growing inspection demand fails to translate into sustained earnings growth.

Hedge fund positioning shows a mixed signal. As per our database, 81 hedge fund portfolios held KLA Corporation at the end of the second quarter, up from 71 in the previous quarter. That is a steady climb, suggesting institutional interest in the company is improving. Among its peers, Applied Materials (NASDAQ:AMAT) was held by 137 hedge funds, down from 138, while Onto Innovation (NASDAQ:ONTO) was held by 75 hedge funds, up from 67, and Lam Research (NASDAQ:LRCX) was held by 139 hedge funds, up from 123. This shows institutional investors grew most confident in Lam Research Corporation during the quarter, with KLA Corporation and Onto Innovation also seeing solid gains, while Applied Materials held roughly steady with only a marginal dip in ownership.

Short interest data also paints a fairly calm picture, with just 1.86% of KLA Corporation shares sold short. That compares with 1.71% for Applied Materials, Inc., 2.07% for Lam Research Corporation, and a much higher 7.68% for Onto Innovation Inc. Because fewer investors are betting against KLA Corporation than Onto Innovation Inc., there is little direct bearish pressure on the stock. Still, its premium valuation and reliance on continued chip spending remain the key things to watch.

Valuation Analysis

KLAC's forward P/E is 26.95x. Applied Materials, Inc., Lam Research Corporation, and Onto Innovation Inc. trade at forward P/Es of 21.14x, 24.88x, and 16.84x, respectively. KLAC's own forward P/E was 33.44x on December 31, 2025, meaning its current valuation is approximately 19% lower. We believe the current valuation reflects investor concerns about semiconductor spending cycles, export restrictions, and the durability of AI-driven equipment demand. However, its premium to all three peers suggests that the historical decline has reduced expectations without making the shares an obvious bargain. KLA's fiscal 2026 revenue increased 11.7% to $13.6 billion, while fourth-quarter adjusted earnings per share rose approximately 12% from $0.94 to $1.05, supported by annual free cash flow of $3.77 billion. We believe continued earnings growth could support the current valuation, but a narrowing premium would reduce shareholder returns even if profits keep rising. If KLA can convert increasing chip complexity and advanced packaging demand into sustained earnings and cash flow growth, the shares could offer attractive long-term returns, although we would prefer a lower entry price to provide more protection against a slower semiconductor spending cycle.

Previously, we covered a bullish thesis on KLA Corporation (KLAC) by Quality Equities in January 2025, which highlighted semiconductor tailwinds, TSMC's capex expansion, and AI-driven demand for KLA's process control tools. KLAC's stock price has appreciated by approximately 94.19% since our coverage. We believe KLAC could be a good long-term investment at a lower price, as its premium valuation could limit returns even if earnings continue growing, particularly if semiconductor spending slows.

KLA Corporation is not on our list of the 40 Most Popular Stocks Among Hedge Funds . While KLAC could benefit from growing demand for advanced chip inspection and packaging tools, we believe certain AI infrastructure stocks offer far stronger long-term potential at a much more attractive entry point. If you are looking for an AI stock more promising than KLAC that operates as a critical AI tollbooth and stands as the most important company in the world, check out our report about this must-own AI stock .

news.Title: Trading Day: AI light, Brazil flight
news.Content:
By Jamie McGeever

ORLANDO, Florida, Oct 26 (Reuters) - Stocks mostly rose on Monday, lifted by renewed optimism around AI as Anthropic filed for a US IPO and as investors awaited more 'Big Tech' earnings later this week. Weaker oil prices also support risk appetite.

The big exception, however, was Brazil, where financial assets plunged ‌following left-wing incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's shock win in Sunday's presidential election.

In my column today, I look at whether 'stagflation' pressures may be building in the US. ‌A deflating artificial intelligence bubble puts downward pressure on Wall Street and wider economic growth, but the revival of oil and energy prices is putting upward pressure on inflation. It's a tricky one for investors, and the ​Fed.

Today's Key Reads

• Brazil stocks, real tumble as Lula win ends bullish run

• Anthropic's IPO filing shows explosive growth, risks and staggering costs

• Meta eyes record $95 billion equity raise to fund AI expansion

• In China, the AI bubble has already burst

• Fed to hit pause on rate hikes, but maybe not for long

• Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: Brazil -14%. Asia mixed, Europe and UK up around 0.8%. Wall Street higher: Nasdaq +0.8%, S&P 500 +0.7%, Dow +0.3%.SECTORS/SHARES: Seven sectors on the S&P 500 rise, four fall. Tech +1.5%, comms services -1.4%. Tesla +5%, DoorDash -6%.FX: Brazilian real -8.5%, biggest fall since devaluation in 1999. Philippine peso sinks ‌to record low near 64.00/$. US dollar index edges higher.BONDS: ⁠Brazil buys back bonds, cancels auctions. US 2-year auction is ok — foreign demand dips, domestic demand surges.COMMODITIES/METALS: Oil slips — Brent -0.8%, WTI -1.5%. Gold +0.5% back above $4,000/oz.

Today's Talking Points:

AI funding blitz

If investors were showing signs of AI fatigue in recent weeks, they're hiding it well as this week gets underway. On Monday, ⁠Anthropic filed for a US IPO, Meta announced plans for a $95 billion equity raise, and SpaceX said it has struck a $40 billion deal with Apollo Global Management for AI chip funding. The Anthropic IPO could value the company at a record-breaking $1.5 trillion or more, and Meta's capital raise would also be a record.

The eye-popping sums needed to fund the AI buildout have begun to suck some of the ​air ​out of the AI bubble, but that was shrugged off on Monday, at least temporarily — tech and AI ​stocks fueled a solid rebound on Wall Street. Competition for investor ‌capital is heating up.

Brazil

Politically, Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's surprise election victory on Sunday was truly historic: never before had a candidate won the decisive second-round vote after losing the first. It also means a record-setting fourth term for Lula, who turns 81 on Tuesday. Unsurprisingly, given the historic significance of Lula's comeback, there was a reaction across Brazilian markets.

Story Continues

Few doubt the scale of Brazil's fiscal and economic challenges, but Monday's collapse in Brazilian assets is likely to reverse, to some degree. Part of the selloff was because investors were caught so flat-footed. As late as Sunday, prediction markets were pointing to an 80% chance of a win for Senator Flavio Bolsonaro. But Lula's scope to push through an agenda that investors fear will ‌be limited, due to Bolsonaro's backing in Congress.

Central bank bonanza

This week is one of the busiest in years ​for policymaking in the world's developed economies, with half of the G10 central banks set to decide interest ​rates. Monetary authorities in New Zealand and Canada are widely expected to hike by ​25 basis points, while those in the US, euro zone and Japan are expected to keep them on hold but signal possible increases in ‌December.

The common enemy is inflation, which is already too sticky in many ​countries. Oil and global energy prices remain elevated ​as war continues to choke Middle East supply routes, and the worry for policymakers is this bleeds into core inflation and becomes embedded in inflation expectations. But if the AI bubble deflates, growth, consumer confidence and investor sentiment could deflate too, putting policymakers in an even tighter bind.

What could move markets tomorrow?

• Japan services producer price inflation (September)

• ​South Korea GDP (Q3, advance)

• US Treasury sells $70 billion of 5-year notes ‌at auction

• US durable goods (September)

• Corporate earnings, including Visa, Coca-Cola, Boeing, Seagate Technology, HSBC, Novartis

news.Title: Why Google might avoid an earnings 'reckoning' this week
news.Content:
Google's ( GOOG ) investors have a few things in their favor coming into earnings day this week that Meta ( META ) investors weren't afforded when the tech giant reported a few negative surprises .

"Google has already done some of its fundraising and indicated a 'significant' increase in capex next year when it reported Q2, so that particular reckoning may be behind it," D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria wrote in a note on Monday. "It is worth noting that Mr. Brin and Mr. Page moved out of California before the 1/1/26 cutoff and may be able to avoid having to sell their shares. Which means that investors will be able to focus on the Anthropic-driven growth in Google Cloud."

Meta surprised investors last week on several fronts.

The company posted negative free cash flow for the first time since 2012 amid aggressive AI spending. It signaled more aggressive spending in coming quarters.

To fund that spending, it further surprised investors by establishing a new class of nonvoting Class C common stock, which effectively serves as a 2-for-1 stock split.

Under the scheme — in part designed to keep founder and CEO Mark Zuckerberg working in California as the 5% billionaire's tax looms — existing shareholders will receive one new nonvoting Class C share for every Class A or Class B share they hold. Trading is slated to begin in January 2027.

Issuing nonvoting stock allows Zuckerberg to raise external capital for Meta's AI build-out without diluting his personal voting control over the tech giant.

Meta shares have come under pressure on fears Zuckerberg may have to sell shares to pay for his Prop 40 tax bill.

But as Luria pointed out, Google investors need not worry on this front.

Co-founder Larry Page bought two Miami estates for a combined $173.4 million, the Wall Street Journal reported earlier this year. His co-founder, Sergey Brin, moved to the Nevada side of Lake Tahoe and also bought a home in Miami this year, Fortune reported.

"We expect the company to discuss its plans to regain primacy in AI, where it is now a 2nd or 3rd place in each of the markets — 2nd in chat to ChatGPT, 3rd in enterprise to Anthropic and OpenAI, and now even trailing Meta's Muse in the personal AI assistant market," Luria wrote about Google's upcoming earnings report.
