Nevertheless, KLAC management has highlighted that calcium fluoride optical components can have lead times of 18-24 months or longer, potentially limiting production flexibility. The company expects KLA's share of the advanced packaging market to increase to approximately 7-8% in 2026 from only a few percentage points in 2023. The increasing application of front-end manufacturing processes in advanced packaging is driving demand for more sophisticated inspection and metrology solutions. Growing adoption of hybrid bonding and high-density interconnect technologies should further expand KLA's addressable market.

The company is well-positioned to capitalize on increasing wafer fabrication equipment (WFE) spending, supported by AI infrastructure investments, semiconductor capacity expansion and technology transitions. The company has established a long-term annual services revenue growth target of 13-15%, supported by increasing equipment installations, maintenance requirements, upgrades and productivity-enhancing solutions. Approximately 80% of services revenues are contract-based, providing recurring revenue visibility. Strong equipment shipments in calendar 2026 and 2027 should expand the installed base, creating additional opportunities for service contracts and customer support.

Conclusion

KLA's strong positioning in the semiconductor process control market, accelerating AI infrastructure investments and robust demand for advanced packaging solutions bode well for its growth prospects. Increasing process control intensity, rising HBM adoption and expanding WFE spending are expected to sustain revenue momentum. A strong backlog and growing services business further strengthen its long-term outlook.

news.Title: AMAT vs. LRCX: Which Stock Has an Edge in the WFE Space?

This company is expected to post quarterly earnings of $0.81 per share in its upcoming report, which represents a year-over-year change of -25.7%.

Revenues are expected to be $1.71 billion, down 5.7% from the year-ago quarter.

Estimate Revisions Trend

The consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has been revised 39.22% higher over the last 30 days to the current level. This is essentially a reflection of how the covering analysts have collectively reassessed their initial estimates over this period.

Investors should keep in mind that an aggregate change may not always reflect the direction of estimate revisions by each of the covering analysts.

Price, Consensus and EPS Surprise

Earnings Whisper

Estimate revisions ahead of a company's earnings release offer clues to the business conditions for the period whose results are coming out. Our proprietary surprise prediction model -- the Zacks Earnings ESP (Expected Surprise Prediction) -- has this insight at its core.

The Zacks Earnings ESP compares the Most Accurate Estimate to the Zacks Consensus Estimate for the quarter; the Most Accurate Estimate is a more recent version of the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate. The idea here is that analysts revising their estimates right before an earnings release have the latest information, which could potentially be more accurate than what they and others contributing to the consensus had predicted earlier.

Thus, a positive or negative Earnings ESP reading theoretically indicates the likely deviation of the actual earnings from the consensus estimate. However, the model's predictive power is significant for positive ESP readings only.

A positive Earnings ESP is a strong predictor of an earnings beat, particularly when combined with a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy), 2 (Buy) or 3 (Hold). Our research shows that stocks with this combination produce a positive surprise nearly 70% of the time, and a solid Zacks Rank actually increases the predictive power of Earnings ESP.

Story Continues

Please note that a negative Earnings ESP reading is not indicative of an earnings miss. Our research shows that it is difficult to predict an earnings beat with any degree of confidence for stocks with negative Earnings ESP readings and/or Zacks Rank of 4 (Sell) or 5 (Strong Sell).

How Have the Numbers Shaped Up for Alps Alpine Co Ltd. - Unsponsored ADR?

For Alps Alpine Co Ltd. - Unsponsored ADR, the Most Accurate Estimate is the same as the Zacks Consensus Estimate, suggesting that there are no recent analyst views which differ from what have been considered to derive the consensus estimate. This has resulted in an Earnings ESP of 0%.

On the other hand, the stock currently carries a Zacks Rank of #1.

So, this combination makes it difficult to conclusively predict that Alps Alpine Co Ltd. - Unsponsored ADR will beat the consensus EPS estimate.

Does Earnings Surprise History Hold Any Clue?

Analysts often consider to what extent a company has been able to match consensus estimates in the past while calculating their estimates for its future earnings. So, it's worth taking a look at the surprise history for gauging its influence on the upcoming number.

For the last reported quarter, it was expected that Alps Alpine Co Ltd. - Unsponsored ADR would post earnings of $0.02 per share when it actually produced a loss of -$0.21, delivering a surprise of -1,150.00%.

Over the last four quarters, the company has beaten consensus EPS estimates three times.

Bottom Line

An earnings beat or miss may not be the sole basis for a stock moving higher or lower. Many stocks end up losing ground despite an earnings beat due to other factors that disappoint investors. Similarly, unforeseen catalysts help a number of stocks gain despite an earnings miss.

That said, betting on stocks that are expected to beat earnings expectations does increase the odds of success. This is why it's worth checking a company's Earnings ESP and Zacks Rank ahead of its quarterly release. Make sure to utilize our Earnings ESP Filter to uncover the best stocks to buy or sell before they've reported.

Alps Alpine Co Ltd. - Unsponsored ADR doesn't appear a compelling earnings-beat candidate. However, investors should pay attention to other factors too for betting on this stock or staying away from it ahead of its earnings release.

For the first three, the broker expects modest beats and raises, with limited upside to gross margins and slight upside to revenues coming from data center/AI as well as Autos and Industrial. A common thread across the group is pricing.

BofA notes that better pricing for large OEMs, meaning flat to up 5% versus the traditional 1-5% price decline, is already expected, so any upside beyond that would come as a positive surprise.

STMicroelectronics is expected to deliver a modest beat and raise, with data center as the main storyline. BofA thinks the market may expect STM to lift its DC revenue guide to $3 billion for CY27, in line with BofA's own estimate, driven by Optical.

The harder question is margins. BofA believes investors need confidence that gross margins can move above 40% next year, which could come from mix, since BofA believes optical gross margins are above 50%, and/or from pricing for large OEMs.

Unsure what to buy ahead of earnings? Our AI's recent pre-earnings calls delivered gains of +77% to +118% after results dropped. See this month's earnings picks »

Infineon also looks set for a modest beat and raise, and here the AI angle is about power. BofA thinks the market may expect IFX to guide combined FY27E AI and server CPU power revenues of €3.5-4 billion, while BofA's own estimate of €4.1 billion sits above the top of that range. Pricing is where the picture becomes more nuanced.

BofA expects the Autos business, which makes up 75% of the ATV division, to pass on 5-10% inflation from foundries.

We use Relative Strength Index (RSI), one of the most commonly used technical indicators, for spotting whether a stock is oversold. This is a momentum oscillator that measures the speed and change of price movements.

RSI oscillates between zero and 100. Usually, a stock is considered oversold when its RSI reading falls below 30.

Technically, every stock oscillates between being overbought and oversold irrespective of the quality of their fundamentals. And the beauty of RSI is that it helps you quickly and easily check if a stock's price is reaching a point of reversal.

So, by this measure, if a stock has gotten too far below its fair value just because of unwarranted selling pressure, investors may start looking for entry opportunities in the stock for benefiting from the inevitable rebound.

However, like every investing tool, RSI has its limitations, and should not be used alone for making an investment decision.

news.Title: NVDA vs. LRCX: Which AI Semiconductor Stock Is the Better Buy?
news.Content:
NVIDIA Corporation NVDA and Lam Research Corporation LRCX are two leading semiconductor stocks benefiting from the artificial intelligence (AI) boom.

NVIDIA powers AI workloads through its advanced computing chips and platforms, while Lam Research provides essential manufacturing equipment used to produce advanced chips and memory. Both companies are benefiting from rising AI infrastructure investments, but their growth opportunities, valuations and risks differ.

With NVIDIA trading at a lower price-to-earnings (P/E) multiple and Lam Research delivering stronger year-to-date stock gains, which semiconductor stock offers investors a better buying opportunity today? Let's find out.

NVDA: AI Leadership Supports Strong Growth Prospects

NVIDIA delivered an impressive second-quarter fiscal 2027 performance, with revenues soaring 106% year over year to $96.22 billion. Data Center revenues surged 117% to $89 billion, driven by strong demand for its Blackwell Ultra infrastructure. Non-GAAP earnings per share (EPS) increased 120% to $2.22, while gross margin reached 75%.

NVIDIA Corporation Price, Consensus and EPS Surprise

NVIDIA Corporation price-consensus-eps-surprise-chart | NVIDIA Corporation Quote

NVIDIA's growth opportunities extend beyond hyperscalers to AI cloud providers, enterprises and sovereign customers. The rollout of its Vera Rubin platform and expanding AI infrastructure investments could support further growth. Its third-quarter revenue guidance of $108 billion, plus or minus 2%, and management's preliminary expectation of roughly 70% fiscal 2028 growth signal continued momentum.

However, NVIDIA faces significant challenges. Supply constraints are limiting its ability to meet customer demand, while rising memory costs are expected to pressure gross margins. Management anticipates margins could decline to 71–72% in the fourth quarter before recovering to 72–73% in fiscal 2028.

Geopolitical uncertainty also remains a concern, with the company's forward outlook assuming no Data Center compute revenues from China. Despite these risks, NVIDIA's strong profitability, computing ecosystem and expanding customer base support its long-term investment appeal.

LRCX: AI-Driven Equipment Demand Creates Opportunities

Lam Research is benefiting from growing semiconductor manufacturing requirements as AI chips, high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and advanced packaging become increasingly complex. In the first quarter of fiscal 2027, revenues increased 54.4% year over year to $8.22 billion. Non-GAAP EPS rose 74.6% to $2.20, while non-GAAP gross and operating margins reached records of 52.4% and 40.2%, respectively.

Story Continues

Lam Research Corporation Price, Consensus and EPS Surprise

Lam Research Corporation price-consensus-eps-surprise-chart | Lam Research Corporation Quote

The company's deposition and etch technologies are essential to manufacturing advanced semiconductors. Its customer support business provides another growth driver, generating nearly $2.5 billion in quarterly revenues. Management expects calendar year 2026 systems revenues to increase well more than 40% and projects wafer fabrication equipment spending to exceed $200 billion in 2027.

Nevertheless, Lam Research remains exposed to semiconductor capital-spending cycles. Clean-room availability and component shortages are restricting industry output, and near-term constraints limited its second-quarter revenue guidance to $8.6 billion, plus or minus $400 million. The revenue guidance reflects a 4.6% sequential increase, significantly lower than the 22.3% increase in the second quarter.

China supplied 35% of first-quarter revenues, but management expects a meaningfully lower share in the second quarter. These factors could affect near-term growth.

NVIDIA vs. Lam Research: Which Has a Better Growth Profile?

Analysts' projections suggest NVDA has a better growth profile than LRCX. The Zacks Consensus Estimate for NVIDIA's fiscal 2027 revenues and EPS indicates a year-over-year increase of 88.7% and 95%, respectively. For fiscal 2028, the consensus marks for revenue and EPS suggest year-over-year growth of 67.5% and 69.3%, respectively.

Meanwhile, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for Lam Research's fiscal 2027 revenues and EPS indicates a year-over-year jump of 48.5% and 60.9%, respectively. For fiscal 2028, the consensus marks for revenue and EPS suggest year-over-year growth of 17.2% and 22.2%, respectively.

NVDA vs. LRCX: Valuation and Price Performance

NVIDIA has the valuation advantage, trading at a forward 12-month P/E multiple of 15.18 compared with 23.02 for Lam Research. This difference is notable, given NVIDIA's faster recent revenue growth, higher gross margins and strong revenue outlook.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

Lam Research has delivered superior stock market momentum, with shares rising 33.4% year to date compared with a 13.8% gain for NVIDIA. However, NVDA's lower valuation and stronger growth profile make it more attractive than LRCX.

Conclusion: NVIDIA Is the Better Investment Bet Today

Lam Research offers compelling exposure to rising semiconductor manufacturing spending, advanced packaging and memory production. Its record profitability and favorable industry outlook make it a strong contender.

However, NVIDIA appears to be the better investment bet today. Its faster growth, 75% gross margin, expanding AI customer base and lower P/E multiple offer a more attractive mix of growth and relative value. Supply constraints, memory costs and geopolitical risks remain important considerations, but NVIDIA's leadership in AI computing gives it the edge.

Currently, NVIDIA sports a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy), making it a must-pick compared with Lam Research, which has a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold). You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank stocks here .

news.Title: 南韓KOSPI上演V型反轉收高0.3% 半導體雙雄強彈
news.Content:
受隔夜美股科技股重挫、中東局勢升溫及市場對人工智慧支出放緩疑慮的衝擊，南韓綜合股價指數KOSPI周五(23日)早盤面臨沉重賣壓，盤中一度重跌超過 4%，最低下探至 5305.98 點。不過，午後在半導體權值股買盤回流帶動下，大盤演出戲劇性的「V型反彈」，終場逆勢上漲 16.53 點或 0.30%，收在 5550.30 點。

其中，SK海力士因宣布撤回旗下固態硬碟子公司 Solidigm 的赴美掛牌上市(IPO)計畫，消除了長期困擾股價的潛在利空，自早盤下跌 4.3% 逆轉收漲 4.4%；三星電子尾盤也翻紅收漲約 0.46%。

針對周五的逆轉行情，Fibonacci Asset Management Global 執行長 Jung In Yun 指出：「早盤的拋售迅速反映了諸多利空消息，促使投資人逢低承接遭到超賣的股票。」

他進一步表示，美國公債殖利率大幅回落，有助於舒緩科技股的評價壓力；儘管市場對 AI 支出的疑慮猶存，但在企業獲利前景依然具備韌性的情況下，被壓低的股價已難以忽視。不過，他也強調：「當天的反轉雖展現出買盤承接意願，但若要形成可持續的復甦，仍需即將公布的企業財報給予信心。」

相較之下，三星證券股票銷售交易員 Roy Lim 則認為，這波回升「主要是技術性反彈，是機構投資人在 Solidigm 撤回上市案後買進海力士所推動。」

隨著 10 月以來韓股回檔近兩成，KOSPI 的 12 個月預估本益比已下滑至約 4.2 倍，成為 2006 年有紀錄以來首個跌破 5 倍門檻的兆美元級市場。彭博專欄作家 Garfield Reynolds 指出，南韓在經濟強勁成長期間，其市場折價不僅未縮小反而持續擴大，這意味著一旦市場情緒轉向，南韓股市後續極可能展現超越其他市場的強勁走勢。

然而，籌碼結構仍暗藏隱憂。iM Securities 研究員 Lee Sang-heon 分析，9 月外資大舉賣超時，有八成賣壓是由兩大半導體龍頭的買回庫藏股計畫吸收；他表示：「買回庫藏股僅提供了下檔支撐；當前的重挫並非單純因為庫藏股退場，而是因為市場已步入空頭階段。」

展望後市，韓亞證券研究員 Kim Rok-ho 預期，SK海力士財報將展現至少 30 兆韓元的額外股東回饋空間，且買回並註銷庫藏股的可能性高於發放股利。但未來資產證券研究員 Kim Seok-hwan示警，獲利及長期合約題材已充分反映於股價中，推升股價的動能自 8 月起由獲利成長轉向股東回饋，這項轉變本身可能就是景氣循環接近頂部的信號。

news.Title: Better Memory Stock: Micron vs. Sandisk
news.Content:
Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) and Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) are members of an elite club. Only four stocks in the S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) have tripled or more so far in 2026. Micron and Sandisk make up half that group.

Sandisk has been the bigger winner by far this year. But that performance is water under the bridge. Which is the better memory stock to buy now?

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 14x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Two different kinds of memory stocks

Micron and Sandisk are similar in some respects. However, they're two very different kinds of memory stocks.

The most important difference between the two companies is the types of memory they focus on. Micron makes high-bandwidth memory (HBM), dynamic random access memory (DRAM), and NAND memory. Sandisk specializes in NAND flash memory.

HBM is Micron's crown jewel these days. In the company's fiscal 2026 fourth quarter, HBM revenue growth exceeded total revenue growth. Management said that it has completed sales agreements "for the vast majority" of its 2027 calendar-year HBM supply at significantly higher prices than it obtained in 2026.

Sandisk's NAND flash focus has worked to its benefit, though. Surging NAND prices have allowed the company to capture the full upside without any dilution from memory chips that aren't experiencing as strong demand.

But artificial intelligence (AI) serves as a massive tailwind for both companies. Memory is critical to AI applications. In particular, the shift to inference and the rising adoption of agentic AI are driving significant demand for multiple types of memory.

By the numbers: how Micron and Sandisk compare

Micron is much bigger than Sandisk. Its market cap tops $1 trillion, making Micron one of the world's top 10 largest technology companies . Meanwhile, Sandisk's market cap is around $200 billion.

Unsurprisingly, Micron also makes more money than Sandisk. In its latest quarter, Micron reported revenue of $54.2 billion and earnings of $37.7 billion. Sandisk's revenue in its latest quarter was $8.97 billion, with earnings of $6.9 billion.

Both companies boast impressive growth. In its fiscal 2026 Q4, Sandisk's revenue soared 372% year over year and 51% quarter over quarter. Micron's fiscal Q4 revenue jumped 379% year over year and roughly 31% quarter over quarter.

Micron and Sandisk are cyclical stocks, which is reflected in their valuations. Micron's shares trade at only seven times forward earnings, while Sandisk's forward earnings multiple is 8x.

Story Continues

Wall Street likes both memory stocks, although the bullish views seem somewhat stronger for Micron. Of the 29 analysts who rated Micron over the past three months, 27 (93%) recommended buying the stock. The consensus 12-month price target for Micron reflects a potential upside of around 74%. Of the 17 analysts who rated Sandisk over the past three months, 15 (88%) recommended buying the stock. The average price target for Sandisk is roughly 60% above the current share price.

The verdict

Both Micron and Sandisk could (and probably will) continue to deliver exceptional returns over the next few years. But I think that Micron is the better memory stock overall.

While Sandisk's pure-play NAND focus is its greatest strength, it's also the company's most significant risk. If NAND prices fall, Sandisk's revenue and profits will sink. Micron faces risks, too, but its breadth across multiple types of memory should provide some cushion.

I also think that Micron could have a bigger long-term opportunity. In particular, I'm excited about the company's prospects in the humanoid robotics market. Humanoid robots require enormous low-power memory. Micron is investing to meet expected demand and believes it will enjoy "a sustained, substantial multi-decade memory demand cycle" beginning later this decade.

My verdict aligns with Wall Street's take on these two stocks. Micron is the better pick right now.

news.Title: 〈陸股盤後〉三大指數開低走高 滬指一度失守3600點 創業板指終止九連黑
news.Content:
中國A股三大股指今(23)日開低走高，上證指數( SSEC ) 結束連2日跌勢，盤中一度失守3600點，創業板指亦終止連跌9日頹勢，本周滬指累跌0.69%，深證成指累跌1.09%，創業板指累跌3.18%

滬指今日收漲0.89%至3690.48點，深證成指( SZI ) 收高2.79%，報11673.83點，創業板指收紅4.16%至2684.1點，滬深兩市成交額人民幣1.96兆元，較前一天放量逾4200億元。

盤面上，人形機器人族群大漲，宇樹科技漲停，本週累漲逾46%，大業股連6天漲停，福萊新材出現5個交易來第3根漲停板，華陽智能、正裕工業、襄陽軸承連2日亮燈，宇樹科技，萬向錢潮、山東威達、派斯林、大豐實業漲停；科創次新股表現亮眼，燧原科技、沐曦股份、摩爾線程等多股漲超10%；晶片股回暖，粵芯半導體、利亞德、奧普特等多股漲停；大金融類股拉升，匯金科技、華林證券、大智慧漲停；影視院線族群走高，中廣天擇、慈文傳媒漲停。

下跌族群方面，電力類股走勢較弱，閩東電力、皖能電力、黔源電力紛紛下挫；銀行族群震盪回落，中國銀行跌超4%，工商銀行、建設銀行跌超3%，農業銀行、江蘇銀行、交通銀行亦跟跌。

消息面上，OpenAI切入人形機器人賽道，執行長奧特曼稱該公司正組建名為「OpenAI Robotics」的新團隊，並公開招募全端硬體、營運、系統及機器學習工程師。本周一(19日)，特斯拉向美國證交會(SEC)提交2026年年度股東大會相關文件，特斯拉在同期提交的年度股東報告中明確表示，第三代Optimus人形機器人已為大規模量產做好準備。

此外，國際顧問機構弗若斯特沙利文近日公布《2026年全球人形機器人市場研究報告》，揭露業界最新產銷數據。今年上半年全球人形機器人銷售達3.6萬台，已超越去年全年3.5萬台的規模，同期市場營收為5.4億美元，產業商業化進程明顯加速。

中信證券表示，當下市場風險偏好、情緒接近冰點，三季報在本月中陸續披露，A股市場可望進行主題投資行情風格切換。此外，機器人流動性、估值、政策、技術、鏈主等催化大都符合過去七輪機器人上漲行情特徵，因此，從策略角度來看，中信證券認為機器人主題行情目前已具備啟動條件。

中歐基金出具研報指出，當前市場處於情緒冰點附近的高波動階段，但需區分兩層邏輯：全球長端利率高位、油價與地緣擾動疊加存量資金調倉，屬於估值與流動性層面的衝擊，往往帶來非線性的殺跌；海外AI資本開支仍在上行，記憶體與算力供給偏緊等線索並修緊，等潛在客戶反映動人的威脅性趨勢。

news.Title: 台股逃過一劫？ 日股跌幅收斂、韓翻紅 「這巨頭」大漲逾4%
news.Content:
受到AI巨頭Meta資本支出攀升疑慮加劇，以及年期信用違約交換報價創近一年以來最高，美股費半指數重挫，影響日韓股市今（23）日同步下挫，日經225指數一度大跌逾1400點，創近三個月新低；韓股KOSPI指數也一度下跌逾4%，不過隨著低接買盤進駐，日韓股午後跌幅明顯收斂，終場收跌214點，來到62693點；韓股收盤成功翻紅小漲0.3%，SK海力士也由黑翻紅勁揚4.42%。

日股盤中重挫逾1400點

日股今早延續日前頹勢，日經225指數盤中最低落至6萬1000點區間，一度重挫超過1400點，創7月底以來盤中新低；22日甚至下跌逾1700點，若與21日收盤價相比，兩日累計跌幅一度突破3000點；不過，午後隨著買盤進場，跌幅明顯收斂，終場收跌214點，來到62693點，跌幅0.34%。

日本金融圈分析，包含程式語言PHP安全漏洞問題在內，多項事件推升對AI產業監管加嚴的預期，進而拖慢技術進展，這一疑慮成為投資人拋售AI概念股的重要因素。

韓股大跌後反彈　SK海力士勁揚4%

韓股同樣受美科技股暴跌拖累，KOSPI一度下跌超過412%，所幸午後指數逐漸回升，終場來到5550點，上漲0.3%，記憶體大廠SK海力士因旗下子公司Solidig取消赴美IPO計畫，激勵股價由黑翻紅，終場勁揚4.42%。。

相較日韓股市深跌反彈，台股因薔琵颱風假休市，暫時未受全球股市震盪影響，至於下週台股是否會受美科技股跌勢影響，仍待觀察。

news.Content:
主動式ETF成分股誰最會漲？《Yahoo股市》交叉比對規模前五大國內股票型主動式ETF的前十大持股，發現除了台積電（2330）、聯發科（2454）等大型權值股外，台光電（2383）、欣興（3037）及奇鋐（3017）也同時獲得四檔ETF青睞。若比較過去一年股價表現，欣興漲幅達582.39%，居共同持股之冠；但若以一年前買進一張、持有至今的價差試算，則由台光電以395萬元領先。

5大主動ETF規模達6298億元 這3檔獲四大ETF青睞

根據最新規模資料顯示，主動統一台股增長（00981A）以2,747億元居冠，其次為主動統一升級50（00403A）、主動中信台灣收益（00406A）、主動復華未來50（00991A）及主動群益台灣強棒（00982A），五檔合計規模達6,298億元。

進一步比對最新前十大股票持股，台積電及聯發科同時入列五檔ETF，台光電、欣興及奇鋐則獲四檔青睞；健策（3653）、旺矽（6223）、台達電（2308）及南電（8046）各進入三檔前十大持股。除了大型權值股，PCB（印刷電路板）、散熱及半導體相關供應鏈，也是這幾檔ETF經理人的主要配置方向。

欣興一年飆582%最會漲！台光電一張賺395萬元最多

若以去年10/22至今年10/22收盤價計算，欣興股價從159元漲至1,085元，一年漲幅達582.39%，為共同持股中漲幅最高的個股；南電以359.17%居次，台光電上漲352.68%，排名第三。

若一年前買進一張，以今年10/22收盤價試算，台光電股價從1,120元漲至5,070元，一張價差獲利達395萬元，居共同持股之冠；健策以383.5萬元排名第二，旺矽以307萬元位居第三。至於漲幅最高的欣興，一張價差獲利則為92.6萬元。

00982A選股最不同！穩懋、亞翔等股入列

值得注意的是，五大主動式ETF的選股方向並非完全一致。00981A、00403A、00406A及00991A，共有台積電、聯發科、台光電、欣興及奇鋐等五檔股票同時進入前十大持股。

相較之下，主動群益台灣強棒（00982A）的前十大持股，除了台積電及聯發科，還包括穩懋（3105）、亞翔（6139）、致茂（2360）、緯穎（6669）及愛普*（6531）等個股，與其他四檔ETF的共同持股組合有所不同，也反映不同經理人的選股策略存在差異。

news.Title: 1分鐘讀財經》台積電ADR狂殺 夜盤又遭血洗！主動式ETF押「這3檔」保命？
news.Content:
小編今天（23）日精選5件國內外重要財經大事。由於市場對科技巨頭砸巨資投入AI的投資報酬率疑慮再起，美股週四（22日）科技與晶片股淪為重災區，費城半導體指數大幅重挫6.72%。其中台積電ADR暴跌4.52%，導致台指期夜盤終場狂跌580點，收在45,654點，失守46,000點大關。不過，台股今（23日）正好碰上颱風假休市，暫時躲過了這波崩盤賣壓。

台股近日跌破重要均線，多空交鋒持續升溫，伴隨盤勢劇烈震盪，各家主動式ETF經理人選股策略原先高度集中在科技股持股的版圖開始洗牌，目前僅剩台積電、台光電、聯發科三檔穩居ETF標配陣容，22日跌破季線，更見經理人狂加金融與傳產股。

【1】台股破季線 主動式ETF趁低掃貨

盤點22日主動式ETF經理人逢低進場掃貨標的，涵蓋台積電、鴻海、日月光投控、聯電等科技權值龍頭，還有台泥、南亞、台化、大成鋼、華航、中華電等低基期傳產股，另有欣銓、聯茂、台燿與力積電等電子零組件個股入列。值得注意的是，欣興、奇鋐、南亞、聯茂、日月光投控及中信金等6檔，更獲得至少2檔主動式台股ETF逢低同步加碼，成為經理人共識的低檔加碼首選。

【2】聯發科法說倒數 雙外資送暖

繼台積電與大立光之後，市場最關注的科技法說會聯發科，將在30日舉行。花旗環球證券指出，市場一直對聯發科TPU開發進度，以及新專案拓展抱持懷疑態度，但聯發科TPU v8專案進展符合預期，今年相關營收可望達到20億美元以上，將成為推動第四季營收強勁成長的重要催化劑（catalyst）；野村證券則提出，市場對聯發科部分擔憂過度，重申「買進」投資評等。

【3】勞保費率明年調升為13％ 雇主年成本增逾百億元

勞動部勞保局22日指出，依《勞工保險條例》規定，勞工保險保險費率自明年1月1日起，由現行12.5％調整為13％，經扣除內含的就業保險費率1％，2027年起，將以12％計收勞工保險保險費。據估算，雇主明年全年可能因此增加逾133.3億元的法定成本。

【4】AI基建燒錢 Meta自由現金流轉負 降至負21.2億美元

Meta公布第三季財報，營收創歷史新高，第四季財測也優於市場預期，但AI軍備競賽的代價浮現。公司調高2026年資本支出預估下限，自由現金流更創上市以來首度轉負，22日早盤股價重挫逾6％。

【5】特斯拉Q3業績報喜 下修全年資本支出

特斯拉第三季業績報喜，營收和獲利雙雙優於市場預期，且資本支出低於華爾街預測，讓上季現金流意外轉正，該公司同時下修全年資本支出。

Up 3,700%, Should You Buy Sandisk Right Now?
news.Content:
The appreciation of Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) stock has been nothing short of phenomenal. Since its formal separation from Western Digital in February 2025, the stock has risen 3,700%, a feat unmatched by any large-cap stock over the same period.

Admittedly, no matter what its future holds, it is unlikely to repeat that growth within such a short time frame. However, history suggests that the chip stock is more likely to pull back than rise over time.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

The rise (and possible future decline) of Sandisk

Indeed, when Sandisk spun off, it did not appear to be on the verge of massive growth. The company specializes in NAND memory and solid-state storage products. In general, memory and storage are commoditized products, and thus, the companies in that business tend to not attract as much investor interest.

Nonetheless, the boom in AI centers led to unprecedented demand for flash storage solutions. The stock price surged as AI stock investors and institutional investors took notice. Soon after, Sandisk joined the Nasdaq-100 and the S&P 500 , leading to additional buying.

The company's financials also played a major role in its gains. Its net income was over $11 billion in fiscal 2026, far better than the $1.6 billion loss in the previous fiscal year.

That profit left it with an attractive valuation despite its massive stock gains. Currently, its P/E ratio is 19, and the immediate future appears bright as its forward P/E stands at just 6.3.

Ironically, seasoned investors' long-term memory may explain the low valuations. These shareholders know that memory companies tend to experience more volatile industry cycles than tech stocks in general. This is because memory and storage command tremendous pricing power in boom times. However, when the down cycle begins, lower demand and price cuts can reduce or even wipe out company profits.

Sandisk has signed customers into long-term contracts, which could mitigate a down cycle. Still, slumps can be exceptionally painful for memory stocks. In the nearly nine years Western Digital owned Sandisk, its stock gained over 75%. Still, since it earned all of those gains in the first year of ownership, it is easy to see why Western Digital later doubted the wisdom of the merger and decided to spin off Sandisk.

Story Continues

The performance of both Sandisk and Western Digital stocks since the separation indicates the AI boom would have ended the slump with or without the separation. Still, performance in previous years suggests storage stocks have not performed well historically, possibly pointing to pain for Sandisk in the foreseeable future.

Should you buy Sandisk stock right now?

The history of Sandisk and its industry in general suggests one should approach its stock with caution.

With Sandisk dominating the S&P 500 in 2026, it implies that it is the stock to own. Still, the stocks in that industry have faced huge sell-offs once the boom ends. That history may also explain why investors have not bid the stock higher despite its 19 P/E ratio.

Indeed, if revenue forecasts prove accurate, Sandisk stock could continue rising. Nonetheless, given Sandisk's history and the history of the memory and storage industries in general, investors should probably assume they missed out on this boom.

news.Title: Chip stocks break a bear trap after a $3 trillion rout — here are the levels bulls need to hold
news.Content: Chip bulls sprang a bear trap on Tuesday. Two sessions later, the floor under it has cracked. The PHLX Semiconductor Index ( ^SOX ) fell more than 6% Thursday, closing below 11,000 — the support that rescued the group twice since September. A bear trap is a breakdown that quickly reverses, catching traders who bet on further losses. This one only worked as long as that floor held. It was the index's worst day since June and its lowest close since July 29. The damage is piling up. All 60 stocks in a Yahoo Finance chip basket are down since Oct. 6, erasing more than $3 trillion in market value, more than $900 billion of it Thursday alone. Lam Research ( LRCX ) and Applied Materials ( AMAT ) have each lost about 30% in that span, and AMD ( AMD ) more than 20%. Nvidia ( NVDA ) has fallen less, but on its size that's more than $600 billion. Lam led Thursday's slide after reporting record revenue Wednesday night. The company said supply limits capped its outlook and that China sales will be "meaningfully down" in December. The selling isn't sparing the giants. Meta ( META ) shed more than $120 billion in market value after its earnings, and SpaceX ( SPCX ) and Amazon ( AMZN ) slid too. Still, the Nasdaq 100 ( ^NDX ) is down about 7% since Oct. 6. Chips are down more than twice as much. The 11,000 floor cracked The index closed near 11,130 on Sept. 14 and again on Oct. 16. Tuesday's dip into that zone reversed sharply, springing the trap. Thursday's break puts the 10,450-10,550 zone in focus. That's where the summer rally started on July 29. The 200-day moving average sits just above it, and Thursday's low stopped a few points short of that line. On the upside, bulls first need to win back 11,000, then 12,600-12,700. That area capped rallies in August and September. Dip buyers haven't given up Semiconductor ETFs saw record flows over the past week, Bloomberg senior ETF analyst Eric Balchunas posted Thursday. "Buying the dip here has [a] pretty good record of working," he wrote. There's little room to hide from the AI trade. "Every index on the planet is basically an AI index," Matt Miskin, co-chief investment strategist at Manulife John Hancock Investments, said on Yahoo Finance's live show Thursday. The close below 11,000 puts the 10,500 area in play if the 200-day gives way. Bulls need a close back above 11,000 in the next couple of days to revive the trap. news.Title: Susquehanna Makes Strong Calls on AMD, Intel, Qualcomm
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Susquehanna is reshuffling price targets across the semiconductor sector ahead of earnings, raising its outlook for AMD ( NASDAQ:AMD ), Qualcomm ( NASDAQ:QCOM ) and Skyworks Solutions while cutting targets for Intel ( NASDAQ:INTC ), Onsemi, Cirrus Logic and Wolfspeed.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Signs with AMD.

Is AMD fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

The firm raised AMD's target to $620 from $550 , Qualcomm's to $185 from $160 , and Skyworks' to $90 from $65 .

Intel's target was cut to $105 from $115 , while Onsemi was reduced to $120 from $150. Cirrus Logic and Wolfspeed were also lowered.

Susquehanna analyst Christopher Rolland said AI remains the biggest source of upside, but the broader semiconductor cycle is also improving.

The firm's SemiSIGnals data showed lead times expanding by roughly two weeks for a second consecutive quarter , while pricing actions are becoming more aggressive.

Susquehanna also expects additional price increases in the fourth quarter and into 2027.

The problem is that not every end market is participating equally.

PC demand is tracking below expectations, which could leave second-half client results for both AMD and Intel below normal seasonal patterns.

In response, both companies are shifting wafer capacity away from PCs and toward servers, where demand tied to agentic AI remains much stronger.

Susquehanna also expects ARM-based hyperscale CPUs to keep gaining share as they increasingly serve as host processors for custom AI accelerators.

Investor Takeaway

I think the most important part of Susquehanna's note is the widening split between AI-driven data center demand and weaker consumer electronics .

For AMD, that is relatively favorable because server demand gives the company another avenue to offset softness in PCs.

For Intel, the same shift helps, but weaker client demand still creates more pressure on the near-term setup.

Qualcomm benefits from the high end of the handset market holding up better, although Susquehanna remains cautious on smartphones overall because of memory constraints and deteriorating demand in China.

For investors, the key things to watch are server revenue, wafer reallocation, semiconductor pricing, hyperscaler capex and whether PC and handset weakness becomes more severe .

The chip cycle still appears to be improving.

But increasingly, the strongest part of that recovery is concentrated around AI infrastructure rather than broad-based consumer demand.

news.Title: Prediction: Sandisk Stock Will Soar After Oct. 29. Here Are 379 Billion Reasons Why
news.Content:
Sandisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) stock has fallen from grace in recent months after delivering a stunning performance in the first half of 2026.

Shares of the flash storage specialist have pulled back 32% since the beginning of July. For comparison, Sandisk stock rose by a stunning 858% in the first half of 2026. The recent slide in Sandisk stock has nothing to do with the company's financial performance. Investors have pressed the panic button and are booking profits in Sandisk amid concerns about the sustainability of the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure build-out .

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

However, a closer look at the developments in the NAND flash industry suggests that the fears about a slowdown in Sandisk's growth are overblown. In fact, I won't be surprised to see the company deliver stronger-than-expected fiscal 2027 first-quarter results on Oct. 29.

Let's check the reasons why Sandisk stock could take off following its upcoming quarterly report.

Image source: Getty Images.

Sandisk's growth and potential don't justify its slide

The incredible demand for NAND flash storage in AI data centers has been Sandisk's biggest growth driver. The resulting supply shortage has led to a massive increase in NAND flash prices, which explains the red-hot growth in Sandisk's revenue and earnings.

The company expects fiscal Q1 revenue of $10.3-$10.8 billion, along with non-GAAP earnings of $45.00 per share. The guidance implies a year-over-year increase of 357% in revenue at the midpoint, along with a 37x jump in non-GAAP earnings per share. Market research firm TrendForce expects NAND flash prices to surge by 235% in 2026, which explains why Sandisk is anticipating such phenomenal growth in fiscal Q1.

Even better, analysts expect Sandisk to sustain its red-hot growth in the current quarter as well. Consensus estimates on Yahoo! Finance predict a 4x year-over-year increase in Sandisk's revenue in the current quarter to $12.2 billion. Meanwhile, earnings per share could increase by 8x to $52.94. So, the recent slide in Sandisk's stock price isn't justified when we consider that the strong NAND flash demand and price environment will continue to remain a tailwind for the company.

Moreover, the NAND flash market is poised for further growth in 2027. TrendForce expects NAND flash industry revenue to reach $379 billion in 2027, up 40% from this year. Of course, the market's growth rate is expected to slow substantially next year compared with 2026's estimated 280%, but that's still a healthy number.

Story Continues

Importantly, Sandisk can make the most of this huge opportunity given that it controls 11% of the NAND flash market, according to Counterpoint Research. A similar share of this market at the end of 2027 could send Sandisk's revenue in calendar 2027 to almost $42 billion, double the revenue it has generated over the past twelve months.

So, Sandisk seems poised to grow at a robust pace over the next year and a half, given the incredible $379 billion addressable opportunity it is sitting on. Throw in the fact that the NAND flash industry will remain undersupplied in 2027 and 2028, according to Citi , and Sandisk should also be able to clock healthy earnings growth.

This probably explains why there has been a slight uptick in Sandisk's earnings per share expectations for the current and the next fiscal year.

SNDK EPS Estimates for Current Fiscal Year data by YCharts

A stronger-than-expected outlook can supercharge the stock

One of the reasons why this AI stock has been under pressure lately is because of concerns that NAND flash supply growth will overtake demand next year. This could erase the pricing advantage that Sandisk has been enjoying.

However, the points discussed above suggest otherwise. Additionally, robust NAND flash demand from AI servers could lead to a sequential increase of 15%-20% in NAND flash contract prices in the current quarter, according to TrendForce. This is why I think Sandisk's guidance for the ongoing quarter may exceed expectations, giving the stock a much-needed boost.

Another reason why Sandisk seems like a no-brainer buy right now is that it trades at an extremely cheap 8 times forward earnings. The S&P 500 index, for comparison, has a forward earnings multiple of 19. Sandisk should ideally trade at a significant premium given its exponential growth rate. So, it makes sense for savvy investors to buy this growth stock before Oct. 29 as strong results and a sunny guidance could set it up for a strong finish to the year.

news.Title: Vicor Corporation Shares Gain 4.5% on Strong Q3 Earnings Growth
news.Content:
Vicor Corporation VICR shares have gained 4.5% since it reported third-quarter 2026 results on Oct. 20. The uptick can be attributed to strong AI-driven demand and rising recurring royalty revenues, which lifted sales, margins and profitability.

The company reported third-quarter 2026 earnings of $1.33 per share, missing the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 4.32%. The figure increased 111.1% year over year.

Revenues surged 78.5% year over year to $197.11 million and surpassed the consensus estimate by 5.4%. Strong Advanced Products sales and higher royalty income supported growth. The company's order backlog increased 166% year over year to $406 million, reflecting robust demand.

VICR's Advanced Products Revenues Accelerate

Advanced Products revenues, including royalties, increased 47.5% sequentially to $138.9 million. The business accounted for 70.4% of total revenues, up from 65.7% in the preceding quarter.

Vicor Corporation Price, Consensus and EPS Surprise

Vicor Corporation price-consensus-eps-surprise-chart | Vicor Corporation Quote

Brick Products revenues increased 18.4% sequentially to $58.3 million and represented 29.6% of total revenues.

Shipments to stocking distributors increased 24.8% sequentially and 16.2% year over year. Exports accounted for approximately 36.1% of revenues, down from 46% in the second quarter of 2026.

Vicor Benefits From Expanding Royalty Income

Product revenues totaled $130.5 million, up 47.1% year over year. Royalty revenues surged 206.6% year over year to $66.6 million from $21.7 million. Sequentially, royalty revenues increased 119.1%, supported by licensing agreements.

The company granted its first vertical power delivery (VPD) license to a leading artificial intelligence (AI) original equipment manufacturer at Stage 2-unit royalty rates. Management noted that part of the quarterly royalty contribution reflected initial payments, while the underlying licensing arrangements provide recurring income.

Vicor also received inquiries from hyperscalers regarding broader licensing agreements. Management expects royalty income to grow as additional customers adopt its intellectual property, although the timing of payments and new agreements could create quarterly fluctuations.

VICR's Backlog Reflects Strong Market Demand

The book-to-bill ratio remained above 1, while backlog increased 7% sequentially to $380 million. Management highlighted approximately $100 million in bookings during the first two weeks of the fourth quarter, including a substantial order for second-generation VPD modules.

Demand remained strong across AI computing, automatic test equipment (ATE), industrial, aerospace and defense markets. The company's ATE business, which serves semiconductor and memory testing applications, now generates more than $100 million in annual revenues.

Management highlighted growing customer interest in second-generation VPD technology following demonstrations at Open Compute. The technology aims to address increasing power density and efficiency requirements for advanced AI processors.

Story Continues

Vicor's Margins Expand Despite Rising Expenses

Gross profit increased sequentially to $134.7 million from $83.1 million. Gross margin expanded 1,030 basis points to 68.3%, benefiting from higher royalty revenues, improved product mix, manufacturing efficiencies and increased volumes.

Operating expenses increased 29.6% sequentially to $62.5 million. Legal expenses, a substantial portion of which are linked to royalty revenues, increased approximately $11.1 million to $16.1 million. Management expects legal expenses to average approximately 20% of royalty revenues in the near term.

Operating income surged 245.1% year over year to $72.1 million from $20.9 million in the year-ago quarter.

VICR Strengthens Cash Position and Expands Capacity

As of Sept. 30, 2026, cash and cash equivalents totaled $513.1 million compared with $453.6 million in the previous quarter.

Operating activities generated $69.7 million in cash compared with $34 million in the second quarter.

Vicor acquired two additional manufacturing sites within 30 miles of its existing Andover facility. The planned Fab-2 and Fab-3 facilities could increase manufacturing capacity nearly fivefold relative to Fab-1.

Management expects initial equipment deployment at Fab-2 in the second quarter of 2027. The expansion will initially target capacity-constrained manufacturing processes. The company expects to fund its expansion plans without raising additional capital.

Vicor Expects Further Product Revenue Growth

Vicor expects fourth-quarter 2026 product revenues to increase approximately 10% sequentially. The outlook assumes another double-digit sequential increase in Advanced Products hardware revenues.

Management also expects at least $43 million in fourth-quarter royalty revenues, assuming no additional licensing agreements. Existing arrangements could generate incremental royalties beyond this baseline.

The company anticipates further margin expansion as revenues increase and manufacturing utilization improves. However, near-term capacity constraints at Fab-1 remain a consideration as Vicor works to expand production capabilities and meet growing customer demand.

Zacks Rank & Upcoming Earnings to Watch

Vicor currently sports a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy).

Alkami Technology ALKT, ASE Technology ASX, and Entegris ENTG are some other top-ranked stocks in the broader Zacks Computer and Technology sector. While ASE Technology sports a Zacks Rank #1, Alkami Technology and Entegris carry a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) each at present. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank stocks here .

Alkami Technology, ASE Technology and Entegris are expected to report their quarterly results on Oct. 28, Oct. 29 and Oct. 29, respectively. While Shares of ASE Technology and Entegris have surged 163.5% and 75.3%, respectively, Alkami Technology shares have plunged 34.5% in the year-to-date period.

news.Title: Can Semiconductor Systems Drive AMAT's Next Growth Phase?
news.Content:
Applied Materials AMAT is gaining from rising demand for advanced chips used in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, especially in its Semiconductor Systems business. In the third quarter of fiscal 2026, Semiconductor Systems generated revenues of $7.04 billion, up approximately 27% year over year.

Growing investment in leading-edge foundry-logic, dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) and advanced packaging is creating opportunities for the company's wafer fabrication equipment, while rising manufacturing complexity supports demand for differentiated process technologies.

Applied Materials is expanding its technology portfolio to capitalize on these opportunities. Its Centris Spectral SiN ALD system supports advanced logic manufacturing, while enhanced Centura Prime epitaxy and Producer Avila 2 PECVD systems target DRAM performance and higher-layer-count high-bandwidth memory.

Beyond revenue growth, Semiconductor Systems is strengthening Applied Materials' profitability. Its non-GAAP gross margin increased to 55.4% in the third quarter from 53.5% a year earlier. The operating margin expanded to 38% from 33.2%, reflecting the value of its technology portfolio and operating leverage.

AMAT anticipates fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 Semiconductor Systems revenues to be approximately $7.9 billion, suggesting 62% year-over-year growth. The outlook indicates that demand across leading-edge logic, DRAM and advanced packaging could sustain strong near-term momentum.

How Competitors Fare Against AMAT

Applied Materials faces competition from Lam Research (LRCX), KLA Corporation (KLAC) and other semiconductor equipment suppliers, although their primary areas of specialization differ. Lam Research secured multiple critical etch wins at a major DRAM manufacturer with its new Akara etch system, which supports 3D DRAM architectures. This was supported by LRCX's customer investments in DDR5, LPDDR5 and high-bandwidth memory.

Lam Research's Aether dry-resist technology was recently selected as the production tool of record for a leading DRAM customer, securing a foothold in this high-growth segment. Although KLA does not compete directly with AMAT across its entire Semiconductor Systems portfolio, both companies can benefit from rising investment in advanced logic, high-bandwidth memory and advanced packaging.

AMAT's Price Performance, Valuation and Estimates

Applied Materials shares have climbed 59.1% year to date, outperforming the Zacks Computer and Technology sector and the Zacks Electronics - Semiconductors industry's appreciation of 15.9% and 18%, respectively.

news.Title: Can Strong Momentum in LoRa Boost Semtech's Long-Term Growth?
news.Content:
Semtech Corporation SMTC is seeing strong growth in its LoRa business as demand increases across industrial, commercial and consumer applications. LoRa-enabled net sales reached a record $58 million in the second quarter of fiscal 2027, up 31% sequentially and 58% year over year. Growth reflects wider adoption of LoRa across different applications, including smart homes, security systems and industrial monitoring. Management expects the business to maintain its momentum, with LoRa revenues projected to grow about 15% sequentially and 65% year over year in the third quarter of fiscal 2027.

Semtech is expanding its LoRa portfolio to address more applications. Its LoRa Gen 4 platform supports higher data speeds while maintaining low power consumption and long-range connectivity. These features can support new uses in smart homes, security and industrial applications. For example, LoRa-enabled sensors can help monitor industrial equipment and support predictive maintenance. In public safety, the technology can also enable sensors to transmit audio for AI-based verification instead of sending simple alerts.

Amazon Sidewalk is another potential growth driver for Semtech's LoRa business. Following Ring's launch of a new range of LoRa-based sensors in the United States, Amazon Sidewalk is expanding internationally, starting with Canada and Mexico, while Europe, Australia and Japan are expected to follow. This expansion could help increase the use of LoRa-based devices in consumer applications through Amazon's network. Meanwhile, LoRa Plus is gaining traction in smart home and security markets, broadening the company's opportunities beyond traditional industrial and commercial use cases.

Strong momentum in LoRaWAN, LoRa Plus and Amazon Sidewalk can also support SMTC's future growth. Management expects LoRa revenues to grow at a rate above its previous 20% benchmark, supported by demand across these applications. With record revenues, new use cases and expanding distribution through Amazon Sidewalk, LoRa could become an increasingly important contributor to Semtech's overall growth.

How Competitors Fare Against SMTC

Semtech faces competition from Texas Instruments TXN and NXP Semiconductors NXPI across the broader industrial and Internet of Things (IoT) markets.

Texas Instruments offers Sub-1 GHz wireless microcontrollers and transceivers designed for applications such as smart meters, building automation and industrial sensors. These products provide long-range connectivity while using little power, making them an alternative for certain applications served by Semtech's LoRa technology. In the third quarter of 2026, TXN's revenues rose 28% year over year to $6.1 billion, while industrial revenues grew more than 40%. The company is expanding manufacturing capacity to support rising customer demand. These investments and its broad wireless product portfolio strengthen TXN's position in industrial and connected-device markets.

Story Continues

NXPI also offers low-power Sub-GHz wireless products for smart metering, home and building automation, asset tracking and industrial monitoring. Its OL2385 transceiver family supports multiple wireless protocols, including Sigfox and Wireless M-Bus, giving customers options for connected-device applications. NXPI's industrial and IoT business reported revenues of $755 million in the second quarter of 2026, up 38% year over year. Its newer processing products, including the i.MX, RT and MCX families, grew 40% year over year, reflecting strong demand for its industrial and IoT portfolio.

news.Title: What to Expect From KLA Corporation's Next Quarterly Earnings Report
news.Content:
KLA Corporation (KLAC), headquartered in Milpitas, California, designs, manufactures, and markets process control, process-enabling, and yield management solutions for the semiconductor and related electronics industries worldwide. With a market cap of $213.3 billion, the company offers surface profilers, nanomechanical testers, chips, and semiconductor assembly solutions. The leading supplier of process control and yield management solutions is expected to announce its fiscal first-quarter earnings for 2027 after the market closes on Wednesday, Oct. 28.

Ahead of the event, analysts expect KLA Corporation to report a profit of $1.18 per share on a diluted basis, up 34.1% from $0.88 per share in the year-ago quarter. The company beat or matched the consensus estimates in each of the last four quarters.

news.Title: Monolithic Power (MPWR) Reports Next Week: Wall Street Expects Earnings Growth
news.Content:
Monolithic Power (MPWR) is expected to deliver a year-over-year increase in earnings on higher revenues when it reports results for the quarter ended September 2026. This widely-known consensus outlook gives a good sense of the company's earnings picture, but how the actual results compare to these estimates is a powerful factor that could impact its near-term stock price.

The stock might move higher if these key numbers top expectations in the upcoming earnings report, which is expected to be released on October 29. On the other hand, if they miss, the stock may move lower.

While the sustainability of the immediate price change and future earnings expectations will mostly depend on management's discussion of business conditions on the earnings call, it's worth handicapping the probability of a positive EPS surprise.

Zacks Consensus Estimate

This chipmaker is expected to post quarterly earnings of $7.80 per share in its upcoming report, which represents a year-over-year change of +64.9%.

Revenues are expected to be $1.16 billion, up 57.5% from the year-ago quarter.

Estimate Revisions Trend

The consensus EPS estimate for the quarter has been revised 4.33% higher over the last 30 days to the current level. This is essentially a reflection of how the covering analysts have collectively reassessed their initial estimates over this period.

Investors should keep in mind that the direction of estimate revisions by each of the covering analysts may not always get reflected in the aggregate change.

Price, Consensus and EPS Surprise

Earnings Whisper

Estimate revisions ahead of a company's earnings release offer clues to the business conditions for the period whose results are coming out. This insight is at the core of our proprietary surprise prediction model -- the Zacks Earnings ESP (Expected Surprise Prediction).

The Zacks Earnings ESP compares the Most Accurate Estimate to the Zacks Consensus Estimate for the quarter; the Most Accurate Estimate is a more recent version of the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate. The idea here is that analysts revising their estimates right before an earnings release have the latest information, which could potentially be more accurate than what they and others contributing to the consensus had predicted earlier.

Thus, a positive or negative Earnings ESP reading theoretically indicates the likely deviation of the actual earnings from the consensus estimate. However, the model's predictive power is significant for positive ESP readings only.

A positive Earnings ESP is a strong predictor of an earnings beat, particularly when combined with a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy), 2 (Buy) or 3 (Hold). Our research shows that stocks with this combination produce a positive surprise nearly 70% of the time, and a solid Zacks Rank actually increases the predictive power of Earnings ESP.

Story Continues

Please note that a negative Earnings ESP reading is not indicative of an earnings miss. Our research shows that it is difficult to predict an earnings beat with any degree of confidence for stocks with negative Earnings ESP readings and/or Zacks Rank of 4 (Sell) or 5 (Strong Sell).

How Have the Numbers Shaped Up for Monolithic?

For Monolithic, the Most Accurate Estimate is higher than the Zacks Consensus Estimate, suggesting that analysts have recently become bullish on the company's earnings prospects. This has resulted in an Earnings ESP of +1.35%.

On the other hand, the stock currently carries a Zacks Rank of #2.

So, this combination indicates that Monolithic will most likely beat the consensus EPS estimate.

Does Earnings Surprise History Hold Any Clue?

While calculating estimates for a company's future earnings, analysts often consider to what extent it has been able to match past consensus estimates. So, it's worth taking a look at the surprise history for gauging its influence on the upcoming number.

For the last reported quarter, it was expected that Monolithic would post earnings of $5.88 per share when it actually produced earnings of $6.50, delivering a surprise of +10.54%.

Over the last four quarters, the company has beaten consensus EPS estimates four times.

Bottom Line

An earnings beat or miss may not be the sole basis for a stock moving higher or lower. Many stocks end up losing ground despite an earnings beat due to other factors that disappoint investors. Similarly, unforeseen catalysts help a number of stocks gain despite an earnings miss.

That said, betting on stocks that are expected to beat earnings expectations does increase the odds of success. This is why it's worth checking a company's Earnings ESP and Zacks Rank ahead of its quarterly release. Make sure to utilize our Earnings ESP Filter to uncover the best stocks to buy or sell before they've reported.

Monolithic appears a compelling earnings-beat candidate. However, investors should pay attention to other factors too for betting on this stock or staying away from it ahead of its earnings release.

Expected Results of an Industry Player

Another stock from the Zacks Semiconductor - Analog and Mixed industry, NXP Semiconductors (NXPI), is soon expected to post earnings of $4.14 per share for the quarter ended September 2026. This estimate indicates a year-over-year change of +33.1%. Revenues for the quarter are expected to be $3.77 billion, up 18.8% from the year-ago quarter.

The consensus EPS estimate for NXP has been revised 0.5% higher over the last 30 days to the current level. However, a lower Most Accurate Estimate has resulted in an Earnings ESP of -0.27%.

When combined with a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy), this Earnings ESP makes it difficult to conclusively predict that NXP will beat the consensus EPS estimate. Over the last four quarters, the company surpassed consensus EPS estimates three times.

news.Title: 聯電攜手愛普科技推進AI與高效能運算系統電源解決方案
news.Content:
財經中心/綜合報導

聯華電子與愛普科技於今(22)日共同宣布展開技術與製造合作，推進AI與高效能運算(HPC)系統的供電解決方案。此次合作結合聯電的深溝槽電容(Deep Trench Capacitor, DTC)製程技術與可擴充的晶圓製造能力，以及愛普科技的矽電容設計與系統層級整合技術，共同因應下一代資料中心在電源效率方面的挑戰。

隨著AI運算工作負載快速成長，運算系統對電源傳輸的要求日益提高，推動資料中心的電源架構從傳統將穩壓元件配置於電路板上，逐步轉向將電容直接嵌入中介層(Interposer)或基板中。此創新架構可縮短電源傳輸路徑、提升電源完整性(Power Integrity)，並支援先進封裝內更有效率的電壓調節。

聯電與愛普科技的合作已於2026年第三季達成重要里程碑，愛普科技S-SiCapTM Gen2D分離式矽電容設計已完成投片及初步功能驗證。下一階段將針對封裝基板中的電容進行完整的系統級效能與可靠度測試，目標是支援不同的電容量與工作電壓需求。雙方也正探討將合作拓展至其他包括矽中介層嵌入式電容及基板底面電容的產品線，以因應多元的系統設計需求。

聯電資深副總經理洪圭鈞表示：「AI 與 HPC 的成長正推動電源傳輸架構根本性的轉變，從電路板層級的供電，逐步走向晶片層級的垂直電源整合。聯電提供完整的供電解決方案，包括DTC技術，可將高密度電容配置於更靠近運算晶片的位置，以達到更穩定晶片供電效果。聯電透過與愛普科技合作，正致力將可擴充的解決方案推向市場，以克服 AI 基礎設施持續演進所帶來的關鍵供電瓶頸。」

愛普科技總經理洪志勳表示：「採用 DTC 技術的客製化S-SiCapTM 產品成功完成投片及初步晶圓驗證，是展現愛普科技S-SiCapTM 設計彈性與可製造性的重要里程碑。透過與聯電的合作，我們為客戶提供從產品設計到晶圓製造的一站式解決方案。」

聯電的供電解決方案藍圖涵蓋可應用於不同系統架構的分離式與嵌入式矽電容，並延伸至內部電壓調節器等主動元件。聯電亦運用其先進封裝能力，實現更高密度的電源元件整合，以滿足下世代資料中心對更高電壓與電容量的需求。同時，聯電持續投資擴充製造產能，以支援電源與異質整合解決方案。

原文出處： 聯電攜手愛普科技推進AI與高效能運算系統電源解決方案

news.Title: 《陸股》滬指跌1.48% 失守3700點；創業板指跌4.37%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-22 17:12:38 數位內容中心 發佈

中國A股主要指數今(22)日全面收黑，上證指數失守3700點，收於3658.03點，下跌1.48%，日K連二黑；深證成指收於11357.32點，下跌2.96%；創業板指收於2576.90點，下跌4.37%；科創50收於1305.87點，下跌2.78%。盤勢開低走低，尾盤未能明顯修復，整體情緒偏弱。

兩市成交量1兆5,287億元(人民幣,下同)，較前一交易日量增約7%。盤面上，成長與科技權重成為壓力核心，創業板指跌幅最大，顯示成長型資產承壓明顯；科創50同步回落，亦反映科技成長類族群賣壓沉重，市場在收盤前仍未見有效止跌訊號。

AI硬體鏈調整最為明顯，新易盛、中際旭創、天孚通信等權重股走弱，光通信、CPO、PCB、元件、記憶體晶片與先進封裝等普遍下挫；通訊、電子、傳媒等類股跌幅居前，科技相關概念同步承壓。電池產業鏈同樣拖累指數表現，寧德時代走勢疲弱，新能源車與電池相關標的同步偏弱，對創業板指形成明顯壓力。

相較之下，銀行表現較穩，工商銀行盤中再創新高，但仍不足以帶動大盤回穩；家電與部分寬基ETF獲得承接，顯示資金在高檔成交下偏向防守，市場資金仍以控風險為主。

1元併購拚華麗轉身，亞昕科技登興櫃拚營運步步高

《陸股》滬指漲0.12%、日K連二紅；科創50漲1%

news.Content:
（中央社台北2026年10月22日電）中國大陸股市3大指數今天集體走弱，截至收盤，上證綜指跌1.48%，失守3700點；深證成指跌2.97%；創業板指跌4.37%，較今年6月的歷史高點跌逾40%。

每日經濟新聞報導，A股全市場近5000檔個股下跌。滬深兩市成交額人民幣1.53兆元（約新台幣7.34兆元），較上一個交易日放量994億元。

今天韓國及日本股市也大跌。有分析師指出，美國企業公布的財報表現不足以推動股市上漲。同時，中東局勢的不確定性及油價上漲，也在拖累市場表現，導致AI相關股票和銀行股下跌。

news.Title: 《日股》AI、半導體走弱，日經收跌2.65%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-10-22 16:27:05 數位內容中心 發佈

日股今(22)日明顯走弱，日經225指數收於62,907.84點，下跌1,713.40點或2.65%；東證股價指數(TOPIX)收於3,997.50點，下跌46.23點或1.14%。盤面主要受到AI與半導體相關股獲利了結賣壓影響，拖累大盤一路走低，市場風險情緒也同步轉弱。

權值股方面，市場壓力主要來自Lam Research財報公布後股價盤後走弱，引發市場對AI支出前景的疑慮，Tokyo Electron(8035.JP)、Advantest(6857.JP)、SoftBank Group(9984.JP)、SCREEN Holdings(7735.JP)、Lasertec(6920.JP)等權值股承壓，其中Tokyo Electron對大盤的拖累尤為明顯，使指數下行力道擴大。

類股表現方面，半導體與AI相關類股成為主要賣壓來源，非鐵金屬、玻璃與陶瓷製品、銀行、電機設備等類股也偏弱。相較之下，保險、服務與部分醫藥及資訊服務族群表現相對抗跌，顯示盤面資金明顯轉向防禦型標的。
